title: Benefits Operations Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Benefits is one of Rippling's largest and most critical product categories, and the Benefits Operations organization plays a pivotal role in delivering an exceptional customer experience at scale. The team manages tens of thousands of enrollments annually while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.


Rippling is seeking a Benefits Operations Manager to lead a team of Operations Supervisors responsible for multiple operational functions within Benefits. This leader will drive organizational performance through frontline leaders, establish scalable operating mechanisms, identify opportunities for automation and process optimization, and partner cross\-functionally to solve complex operational challenges.


The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with analytical rigor, operational excellence, and the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders to improve customer outcomes and business performance.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Operations Supervisors, building a high\-performing organization through effective manager development and succession planning.
* Own end\-to\-end operational performance across multiple teams, including productivity, quality, SLA attainment, customer experience, and capacity utilization.
* Establish operating rhythms and review mechanisms to monitor KPIs, identify trends, and drive accountability for results.
* Drive workforce planning activities including forecasting, capacity planning, hiring strategies, and organizational design to support business growth and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Support, and other internal stakeholders to address systemic issues, drive alignment, and improve the customer experience.
* Lead and prioritize automation opportunities, process redesign efforts, and tooling enhancements to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Present regular business reviews to senior leadership, highlighting performance outcomes, emerging risks, operational health, and strategic initiatives.
* Proactively identify potential operational challenges and implement preventive controls to mitigate business and customer impact.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 6\-8 years of experience in customer\-facing operations environments such as Insurance operations, benefits operations, business operations/ product operations, or support operations.
* Minimum 3–5 years of people management experience, including direct experience leading frontline managers/ supervisors/team leaders.
* Demonstrated success managing large\-scale operations with ownership of service delivery, performance metrics, and customer outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with experience translating data into strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience with capacity planning, workforce management, organizational design, and resource allocation.
* Proven ability to influence and partner effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.
* Excellent project management and execution skills with a track record of driving complex initiatives to completion.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Strong proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, particularly Sheets/Excel, for reporting and analysis; familiarity with SFDC, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and effectively prioritize competing business needs.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset with a bias for action and continuous improvement.
* Prior experience in a SaaS or high\-growth startup environment preferred.
* Ability to work partly on U.S. hours (Eastern time zone \- EST); standard shift timings would be 1 PM \- 10 PM IST.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

Talent Acquisition Manager( PLEASE NOTE NO CORE HR PROFILE WILL BE CONSIDERED WE NEED ONLY TALENT HIRING MANAGER)

The Role

We're looking for a hands\-on Talent Acquisition Manager to lead a team of approximately 10 recruiters serving a portfolio of enterprise and Fortune 100 clients. This role serves as the critical liaison between the sales team, executive team, and the recruiting team, translating business priorities into recruiting action and ensuring all three groups stay aligned as needs evolve. You're the person who knows where every pipeline stands, why a role isn't filling, and exactly how to fix it. You build people up, hold the bar high, and make sure the team delivers.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership and Development

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 10\+ recruiters working across enterprise and Fortune 100 client accounts
* Build a coach\-first culture grounded in accountability, quality, and continuous improvement
* Set clear performance expectations and hold regular check\-ins to support recruiter development and pipeline visibility
* Onboard new team members and create structured ramp plans to accelerate time to productivity

Recruiting Execution and Performance

* Oversee day\-to\-day recruiting activity, ensuring consistent urgency and quality across all open requisitions
* Monitor KPIs including submittal volume, interview conversion, offer acceptance, and fill rates
* Identify and address pipeline gaps before they affect client delivery
* Drive best practices across sourcing, screening, candidate presentation, and offer management

Reporting and Analytics

* Own team performance dashboards and report out to leadership regularly
* Use data to identify trends, flag issues, and support workforce planning conversations
* Support workforce planning and headcount forecasting with data\-driven visibility

Cross\-Functional Liaison and Client Partnership

* Bridge sales, leadership, and recruiting\- translating new business and client priorities into clear recruiting direction
* Partner with sales on role intake and ensure the team is aligned on what to prioritize
* Serve as a client\-facing contact for recruiting updates, interview coordination, and candidate status

Process and Strategy

* Identify opportunities to improve recruiting workflows, tools, and team processes
* Contribute to recruiting playbooks, SOPs, and strategic initiatives around team growth and service delivery

What We're Looking For

Experience

* 7\+ years of recruiting experience, with at least 4 years in a team lead or management capacity
* Background in IT staffing, technical recruiting
* Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise clients across complex, multi\-requisition engagements
* Familiarity with a broad range of IT disciplines

Skills and Competencies

* Strong coaching instincts with a track record of developing recruiters
* Data\-fluent, comfortable building and interpreting recruiting metrics and presenting findings to leadership
* Excellent organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage competing demands across a high\-volume team
* Clear, professional communicator with polished client\-facing skills
* Proficiency with ATS platforms and standard recruiting tools
* Ability to operate in a fast\-moving environment while maintaining high standards for quality and candidate experience

Why SCIGON

* Established client base with deep, long\-term relationships across 17 Fortune 100 companies
* A tenured internal team that knows how to get things done and genuinely supports each other
* Real ownership over how the recruiting function operates and grows
* A leadership team that values both speed and strategic thinking
* Opportunity to shape recruiting culture and process at a firm that's been in the market for over 15 years and continues to grow

description:
**Job Title:** Cashier

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Industry:** Garment Manufacturing (Woven Segment )  
**Location:** Patravakkam, Chennai  
**Reports To:** HR Manager

**Job Summary:**

The Cashier is responsible for managing all petty cash transactions within the HR Department, ensuring accurate record\-keeping, timely disbursement of approved expenses, and proper accounting through the company's financial systems. This role bridges HR operations and finance, and requires both accounting and system proficiency to support smooth administrative and employee\-related cash processes.

**Key Responsibilities:1\. Petty Cash Management**

* Maintain, handle, and disburse petty cash as per company policy.
* Ensure proper authorization before releasing any cash.
* Reconcile petty cash on a daily/weekly/monthly basis with supporting bills and vouchers.

**2\. Financial \& System Entry**

* Record all cash transactions in accounting or ERP systems (e.g., Tally, SAP, or in\-house software).
* Generate system\-based petty cash reports and submit them to HR and Accounts.
* Monitor and update petty cash balance regularly, and request replenishment as needed.

**3\. Coordination with HR Team**

* Handle employee\-related reimbursements (transport, food allowance, medical advances, etc.) in coordination with HR officers.
* Maintain confidentiality and proper records for employee financial dealings.
* Support HR\-led events or welfare initiatives requiring petty cash transactions.

**4\. Documentation \& Compliance**

* Maintain proper documentation for all cash disbursements with verified receipts.
* Ensure compliance with internal audit and finance policies.
* Submit timely reports and statements to HR Manager and Accounts/Finance Department.

**5\. Support \& Reporting**

* Provide regular cash summary reports to the HR Manager.
* Assist in budget planning for HR\-admin activities requiring petty cash.
* Coordinate with the accounts department during internal/external audits.

**Qualifications \& Skills:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Commerce, or Business Administration.
* 2–3 years of experience in cashiering or petty cash management in a garments or manufacturing setup.
* Good knowledge of accounting systems (Tally, ERP, SAP, or similar).
* Strong Excel skills and familiarity with digital record\-keeping.
* Honest, detail\-oriented, and well\-organized.

**Desirable Attributes:**

* Trustworthy and discreet in handling employee\-related financial matters.
* Clear communicator with the ability to work closely within the HR team.
* Strong sense of responsibility and urgency in managing funds.

* Candidate Relationship Management

* Communication \& Negotiation
* Attention to Detail

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Candidate joining ratio.
* Quality of hires.
* Candidate and hiring manager satisfaction.

Working Hours

* Flexible part\-time opportunity.
* Purpose\-driven organization in the education sector.
* Exposure to diverse hiring across education and corporate functions.
* Opportunity to contribute to building high\-performing teams.

Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.

Gold Loans is a key secured lending product with high volume, fast turnaround expectations and requires strict discipline in risk, valuation, purity testing, and customer trust management. **Job Context:**  

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. The role balances growth, yield optimization, and compliance while managing a small but high?impact team and ensuring branch\-level risk controls **Key Challenges:*** Achieving aggressive customer acquisition, disbursement and tonnage growth in competitive local markets.
* Maintaining strict LTV adherence, gold purity compliance, and accurate valuation amid gold price fluctuations.
* Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.
* Driving collection resolutions for 0–30 DPD while preventing slippages.
* Ensuring branch audit scores \>90% with zero tolerance deviations.
* Delivering consistent customer experience in high\-sensitivity product category (emotional asset).
* Motivating and developing frontline staff for continuous sales and service productivity

* Drive new customer disbursements as per percentile role benchmarks.
* Ensure net growth and tonnage growth in line with branch plan.
 **Yield \& Profitability Management*** Achieve onboarding yield benchmarks
* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.
 **Portfolio Quality \& Risk Management*** Maintain auction\-to\-book ratio
* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines
 **Collections \& Delinquency Management*** Deliver resolution for 0–30 DPD bucket.
* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.
* Support recovery actions as per internal guidelines.
 **Compliance, Audit \& Governance*** Achieve audit score as defined, ensure closure of audit findings.
* Maintain zero\-tolerance on operational deviations and regulatory breaches.
* Ensure accuracy in process, record keeping, and vault management.
 **Customer Service \& Branch Experience*** Ensure high service quality, fast turnaround time, and seamless grievance resolution.
* Maintain branch hygiene, safety, and security standards.
 **People Leadership \& Productivity*** Lead ABM, Gold Valuer, GLO, and CSE for daily performance.
* Conduct coaching, on\-the\-job training, and reviews.
* Ensure manpower productivity as per branch benchmarks
**5\) Job Purpose of Direct Reports:** Describe the job purpose of the direct report/s to the job (in 2\-3 lines for each report)
=================================================================================================================================

  

* Assistant Branch Manager: Support branch business operations, supervise frontline staff, and drive daily productivity.
* Manager – Gold Valuation: Ensure accurate valuation, purity checks, risk adherence, and secure handling of gold assets.
* Gold Loan Officer: Acquire customers, drive disbursement, manage renewals, and maintain documentation accuracy.
* Customer Service Executive: Deliver superior customer experience, manage service transactions, and support branch operations.

title: Senior Executive – Workforce Management (KEKA Operations)
description:
### **Job Summary**


The Senior Executive – WFM (KEKA Operations) will be responsible for managing daily attendance operations, roster updates, employee attendance validation, KEKA administration, payroll attendance support, and ensuring compliance with company attendance policies. The role requires close coordination with HR, Operations, Payroll, and employees to maintain accurate attendance records and timely payroll processing.### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **KEKA Attendance \& Roster Management**

* Update employee rosters in KEKA as per approved schedules.
* Perform manual attendance updates (Present) in KEKA based on Spot Logout Reports.
* Update manual attendance (HD) in KEKA based on production login hours.
* Maintain attendance for new joiners until biometric registration is completed (average 5 days from DOJ).
* Update Reporting Officer (RO), Department, and Process details in KEKA as per approved requests.

#### **Attendance Validation \& Employee Requests**

* Validate and approve/reject Attendance Regularization (AR) requests based on supporting evidence.
* Validate and close attendance\-related tickets, including:
	+ Missed Punch\-In/Punch\-Out
	+ Attendance discrepancies
	+ Week Off\-related issues
* Handle approximately 14–15 attendance tickets daily.

#### **Monthly Attendance \& Payroll Support**

* Download and compile monthly attendance data from KEKA.
* Prepare the final attendance sheet after validating attendance status and penalty data.
* Validate leave balances and update attendance before payroll processing.
* Validate Sandwich Policy cases and update attendance accordingly.
* Prepare the Salary Hold eligibility list based on the first payroll validation.
* Coordinate with Payroll, HR, and Operations to ensure accurate attendance data before payroll closure.

### **Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of KEKA HRMS.

title: Manager & Division Head
description:
**Job Category:** Wild Rescue
**Location:** HQ \- Noida
**Date Posted:** 13\-July\-2026
**Qualification** \- At least a master’s degree in Biological Sciences (Wildlife biology, Ecology, Forestry, Environmental sciences), Veterinary Science or equivalent.  



  

**Experience** \- 8\-10 years in conservation, particularly in wildlife rescue and rehabilitation.

  

  

**Role Context:** The Division Head – Wild Rescue shall provide strategic, operational, technical, and administrative leadership for all projects and programmes under the Wild Rescue Division. The role is responsible for ensuring effective implementation, coordination, monitoring, compliance, financial management, stakeholder engagement, and quality delivery of all divisional activities. The incumbent shall work closely with Project Heads, Programme Officers, field teams, support departments, government agencies, donors, and external stakeholders to achieve organizational and project objectives. The position shall function as a key leadership role responsible for strengthening programme quality, operational efficiency, team development, institutional partnerships, and long\-term growth of the division. The Key Responsibilities are as follows:

  

  

* Lead strategic planning, supervision, and monitoring of projects under the Wild Rescue Division in consultation with Project PIs and organizational leadership.


* Develop concepts, strategic frameworks, and project plans for new and existing initiatives.


* Lead fundraising efforts, donor engagement, and development of project proposals in coordination with the Development Division and project teams.


* Ensure effective implementation of project activities, deliverables, outcomes, and outputs as outlined in approved Project Implementation Plans (PIPs).


* Oversee project data archiving, documentation systems, and appropriate utilization of data for reports, publications, and knowledge products.


* Lead preparation and dissemination of technical reports, scientific manuscripts, policy documents, and communication outputs related to division projects.


* Build and maintain partnerships with government agencies, research institutions, NGOs, academic organizations, scientific bodies, and experts to strengthen division objectives and project implementation.


* Mentor, guide, and monitor project staff, interns, consultants, and team members associated with the division.


* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, statutory requirements, donor commitments, and reporting standards across all projects under the division.


* Lead preparation, review, and revision of Project Implementation Plans (PIPs), annual work plans, budgets, and operational strategies.

  

  

**The detailed job description is as follows:**

  

**Project Management \& Operational Oversight \-**

* Ensure effective implementation of all divisional projects in alignment with approved objectives, timelines, donor commitments, and organizational priorities.
* Provide operational guidance to Project Heads and field teams for achieving project outcomes and outputs.
* Conduct periodic reviews, monitoring visits, and performance assessments of projects and field stations.
* Ensure timely completion and submission of technical reports, project reviews, protocols, and organizational documentation.
* Monitor programme quality, field implementation standards, and compliance with organizational procedures.
* Ensure maintenance and updation of divisional databases, rescue records, technical documentation, and reporting systems.
  

  

**Leadership \& Team Management \-**

  

* Provide leadership, mentoring, and professional guidance to divisional staff and project teams.
* Support recruitment, selection, onboarding, and capacity building of team members in coordination with HR.
* Conduct performance reviews and provide developmental feedback to reporting staff.
* Foster a collaborative, professional, inclusive, and performance\-oriented work culture within the division.
* Address team management and employee relations matters in coordination with HR and organizational leadership.
* Identify training needs and facilitate technical and professional capacity\-building programmes for staff and associated stakeholders.
  

  

**Administrative \& Compliance Management \-**


* Ensure compliance with all statutory, legal, regulatory, donor, and organizational requirements related to divisional projects and field operations.
* Oversee maintenance of field stations and ensure operational readiness as per organizational standards.
* Ensure proper documentation, record keeping, and adherence to organizational policies and procedures.
* Approve leave, travel, and administrative requests of reporting team members as per organizational policy.
  

  

**Financial Management \& Resource Utilization \-**

* Oversee divisional budgets, fund utilization, financial planning, and cash flow management in coordination with Finance and programme teams.
* Ensure timely submission and review of financial reports, utilization statements, and budget forecasts.
* Monitor project expenditures to ensure compliance with approved budgets and donor requirements.
* Support development of funding proposals, concept notes, and budgetary documents for new and existing projects.
* Ensure effective and accountable utilization of organizational resources.
  

**Donor \& Stakeholder Coordination \-**


* Maintain effective coordination with donors, government agencies, conservation institutions, research organizations, and partner agencies.
* Support preparation and timely submission of donor reports, technical updates, proposals, and presentations.
* Ensure divisional projects meet donor commitments, reporting timelines, and agreed deliverables.
* Develop and strengthen strategic partnerships to support programme sustainability and institutional growth.
  

  

**External Communication \& Representation \-**

* Represent the organization and Wild Rescue Division at national and international meetings, conferences, workshops, seminars, and technical forums.
* Promote organizational achievements, technical outputs, and conservation outcomes through scientific and public platforms.
* Support publication of scientific papers, technical reports, operational manuals, and communication materials related to divisional work.
* Strengthen visibility and credibility of the organization through professional engagement and stakeholder outreach.

**Monitoring, Evaluation \& MIS \-**

* Ensure timely compilation, review, and submission of monthly, quarterly, half\-yearly, and annual divisional reports.
* Monitor project indicators, outputs, deliverables, and programme impact through structured review mechanisms.
* Facilitate internal review meetings, planning discussions, and monitoring exercises for continuous programme improvement.
* Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and integrity of divisional data and information systems.

**Other Responsibilities \-**

* Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Chief of Conservation, Principal Investigator, or organizational management in the interest of the organization and its programmes.
* Support organizational initiatives, interdisciplinary collaboration, and institutional development activities as required.
  

  

**Desired Skills \-**

  

  

* Experience of working in NGO sector


* Skill in organising, prioritising, scheduling, planning and coordinating projects


* Skills in grant management, technical reporting and monitoring and evaluation


* Ability to multitask, create and work in a team\-oriented, multicultural environment


* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

* Role: HR Intern
* Location: Bangalore (RR Nagar) – On\-site / Hybrid (as per company policy)

* Resource Management: Help manage training schedules, attendance tracking, and feedback collection for corporate capability\-building programs.
* HR Generalist Operations
* HR Analytics: Update and maintain employee records, leave trackers, and performance metrics on internal HR platforms.
* Policy Support: Assist the HR team in drafting and updating internal HR policy manuals and employee handbooks.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
 Educational Background
   

  

* Currently pursuing or recently completed an MBA in HR, PGDM, or a Master’s degree in Human Resource Management / Organizational Psychology.

 Technical \& Soft Skills
   

  

* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills (critical for interacting with management consulting professionals).
* Tools: Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace. Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter or any ATS is a plus.
* Interpersonal Skill: A proactive, problem\-solving mindset with the ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive professional data.
* Adaptability: Eagerness to learn the nuances of the management consulting industry and corporate structural scaling.


 What’s in it for You?
   

  

* Direct Mentorship: Work directly under a leadership team composed of seasoned industry consultants and IIM faculty.
* Consulting Exposure: Gain deep insights into how high\-level corporate talent planning directly impacts business growth and operational metrics.
* Certificate \& Letter of Recommendation: A formal validation of your contributions toward expanding a fast\-growing consulting vertical.

Hedge fund services\- Senior Analyst, POSEIDON FINANCIAL CONTROL

*Founded in Chicago in 1889, Northern Trust is one of the world’s leading financial institutions. We specialise in providing asset servicing solutions and asset management to both institutional and personal clients. The delivery of products and services to this client base is supported through a network of offices around the globe.*


Role


The job requires working for a Global Hedge Fund Administrator, specializing in administering assets of complex hedge funds. This individual will have a strong technical Accounting background; experience working within the Financial Services industry. The position involves understanding of various investment instruments like Equities, Fixed Income Products, Derivatives, Swaps, CFDs, Repos etc. It also requires good understanding of Hedge Fund NAV cycle


Principal Responsibilities

* Review of monthly fund and business entity closing summaries for Fund Administrator
* Report and analyse financial data to be disseminated to Fund Administrator’s clients and their investors
* Generate estimated performance returns
* Close monthly books and records of the funds to general final performance figures,
* Interact with clients and other Hedge Fund Administrator teams to obtain understanding of funds’ activities
* Prepare financial statements for funds
* Work directly with external auditors to ensure accuracy of each fund’s annual financial statements
* Consistently look to streamline and automate the reporting/analytical process with the use of technology


ACCountabilities

Skills

* Good analytical, numerical and reasoning skills
* Time management and delegation skills
* Able to present to clients
* MS Office, word and excel


Qualifications:

* A minimum of 2\-4 years of Hedge Fund Accounting experience
* Experience with Hedge Funds, Investment Management and/or Financial Services strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree with emphasis in Accounting, Master degree a plus
* Excellent Excel and MS Office skills
* Excellent English, grammar, written and oral communication skills
* Adaptive, flexible style with the ability to work in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  



  

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

  

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

At HUL, we believe business growth and purpose go hand in hand. Every day, our people work on brands loved by millions while creating a positive impact on communities and the world around us. Our **People Partners** sit at the heart of this ambition—partnering closely with business leaders, employees, and teams to shape an exceptional employee experience across the employee lifecycle.


If you are passionate about influencing business outcomes through people, navigating complexity, building trusted relationships, and driving meaningful change, **HUL People Partners offers an outstanding platform to learn, lead, and make a lasting impact.**

**Come join us and help shape the future of work at HUL.**

 **JOB PURPOSE**  

The incumbent will be responsible for delivering a best\-in\-class employee experience for the defined span. Acting as the primary HR interface for employees and line managers during key moments that matter, the role involves resolving complex people\-related situations, offering expert guidance on policies and processes, and ensuring alignment with business strategy. This includes leveraging deep knowledge of local laws, Unilever policies, and digital tools to drive transformation in the employee experience space.  

  

You will be part of a team committed to shaping a positive work culture and enhancing the everyday work life of our people, while actively contributing to Unilever’s journey toward a highly tech\-enabled HR function.  

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  

\~ Partner with line managers to provide guidance on individual employee matters and HR processes.  

\~ Resolve complex employee queries using HR policies, systems, legal knowledge, and sound judgment.  

\~ Maintain and update knowledge platforms like UNA Hub and share insights to improve HR technology.  

\~ Support employee relations (ER) casework, ensuring compliance with employment laws and HR policies.  

\~ Provide hands\-on support for performance management, disciplinary actions, grievances, leave, flexible working, and redundancy processes.  

\~ Promote Unilever’s standards of behaviour and help resolve conflicts in line with the Code of Business Principles.  

\~ Build trust with employees and managers by being a neutral and fair facilitator in resolving concerns.  

\~ Identify ER trends, coach managers, and recommend proactive solutions to address root causes.  

\~ Collaborate with HR teams (HRBPs, Payroll, Reward, Talent Acquisition, etc.) to resolve queries and deliver seamless support.  

\~ Act as the first point of contact for complex people\-related matters within the assigned business area.  

\~ Work on simplification / transformation projects that positively impact employee experience.  

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**  

Candidates should hold an MBA in Human Resource Management and have \~4 years of relevant experience in HR.  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**  

Prior experience in handling performance conversations and managing complex employee relations issues, and resolving employee conflicts will be considered an added advantage.  

  

At Unilever, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We welcome applicants from all walks of life and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive/succeed. All applicants will receive fair and respectful consideration, and we actively support the growth and development of every employee.

* Ability and willingness to learn new technology in fast paced environment
* Documentation and ability to follow user guides is critical for this role

* Strong analytic and problem\-solving skills to resolve issues quickly and make decisions that meet customer objectives
* Strong accountability and results\-oriented, with ability to set priorities independently, provide follow\-through, and meet objectives
* Exposure to or willingness to learn process automation, namely PowerShell automation and Shell scripting

* Basic understanding of the fundamentals of financial markets

title: Director - India Transitions & Program Management
description:
We are seeking a senior leader to drive large\-scale transition programs and portfolio execution for our expanding India footprint. This includes in\-house SEI teams, a rapidly growing Global Capability Center (GCC) in Hyderabad, and multiple third\-party partner relationships.


This role will be responsible for **end\-to\-end technology \& operations transition execution** , including:


* Migration of roles from onshore locations into the GCC
* Conversion of partner\-delivered services into SEI\-owned capabilities (“insourcing”)
* Establishing disciplined program management and governance across all GCC initiatives

You will act as the central driver of execution—ensuring that transitions are structured, risks are managed, and outcomes are delivered with speed, quality, and predictability.


This role partners closely with the GCC General Manager, global functional leaders, HR, Finance, and external partners to scale the GCC in a controlled and measurable way.


**What You Will Do:**

**Transition Strategy \& Execution (Core Focus)**

Lead end\-to\-end transition programs moving work into the GCC, including:
Onshore* + offshore role migrations
	Third\-party+ SEI employee conversions (“partner to captive” transitions)
* Define transition roadmaps, sequencing, and prioritization aligned to business strategy
* Build and manage detailed transition plans covering scope, timelines, milestones, and dependencies
* Oversee knowledge transfer, training, and stabilization to ensure successful handoffs to BAU teams

**Partner\-to\-GCC Conversion (Key Differentiator)**

* Drive structured programs to transition work from external partners into the GCC
* Develop business cases for insourcing, including cost, risk, and capability considerations
* Coordinate closely with Procurement, HR, and business stakeholders on:
	+ Talent identification and hiring strategies
	+ Role mapping and capability build\-out
	+ Contract transition and exit planning
* Ensure continuity of service and minimal disruption during transitions

**Program \& Portfolio Management (PMO Leadership)**

* Stand up and lead a GCC\-wide PMO framework for transitions and strategic initiatives
* Maintain an integrated portfolio of all transitions, migrations, and GCC programs
* Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and benefits realization across workstreams
* Drive disciplined execution through standardized tools, templates, and reporting

**Governance \& Reporting**

* Establish governance forums, steering committees, and execution cadences
* Develop executive dashboards and reporting on:
	+ Transition progress
	+ Hiring vs. plan
	+ Cost savings / value realization
	+ Delivery health and risks
* Provide clear, data\-driven insights to senior leadership

**Workforce Planning \& Capacity Alignment**

* Partner with HR and Finance to align hiring plans with transition timelines
* Ensure workforce readiness to support incoming transitions
* Track capacity, ramp\-up progress, and productivity during scaling phases

**Risk, Issue \& Change Management**

* Proactively identify risks across transitions (delivery, people, knowledge retention, vendor dependencies)
* Implement mitigation strategies and escalation frameworks
* Manage change impacts across stakeholders during transitions

**Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as a key interface across global business leaders, GCC leadership, and external partners
* Drive alignment across geographically distributed teams
* Influence outcomes without direct authority in a complex environment

**Continuous Improvement \& Operating Model Evolution**

* Refine transition methodologies, playbooks, and templates
* Identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, and repeatability of transitions
* Support the evolution of the GCC operating model as scale increases

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred
* 15\+ years of experience in **program management, transitions, outsourcing/insourcing, or GCC/shared services environments**
* Proven track record leading:
	+ Large\-scale transition programs
	Onshore+ offshore migrations
	+ Vendor\-to\-captive (insourcing) transformations
* Strong expertise in PMO leadership, including portfolio tracking, governance, and reporting
* Experience building business cases and managing complex stakeholder environments
* Strong understanding of workforce planning and ramp\-up in GCC models
* Ability to operate in a fast\-paced, ambiguous, and globally distributed environment
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills
* Proficiency with tools such as Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project, Smartsheet, or Jira

**SEI’s competitive advantage**

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including comprehensive care for your physical and mental well\-being, hybrid working environment and a work\-life balance that enables you to relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.


Our benefits include Medical Insurance, Term Life Insurance, Voluntary Provident Fund, 10 Predefined Holidays and 2 Floating Holidays in a year, Paid Time off and more.


We are a technology and asset management company delivering on our promise of building brave futures—for our clients, our communities, and ourselves. Come build your brave future at SEI.


**SEI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and so much more…**

After 50 years in business, SEI is a leading global provider of investment processing, investment management, and investment operations solutions. Reflecting our experience within financial services and financial technology our offices encompass an open floor plan and numerous art installations designed to encourage innovation and creativity in our workforce. We recognize that our people are our most valuable asset and that a healthy, happy, and motivated workforce is key to our continued growth. At SEI, we’re (literally) invested in your success. We offer our employees paid parental leave, paid volunteer days, professional development assistance and access to thriving employee networks.

title: Client Development Analyst
description:
**About the Company**

**HISTORY AND KEY FACTS**


Spencer Stuart has more than 60 years of experience in leadership consulting. We have built a reputation for delivering impact for our clients around the world. Spencer Stuart operates as a privately held partnership and has become one of the largest global executive search and leadership consulting firms with:

* 60\+ offices in over 30 countries with more than 50 practice specialties
* 2,200 colleagues around the world from diverse professional and personal backgrounds
* Leading capabilities that we continue to augment. In 2019 and early 2020, we expanded our offerings in leadership development and culture and added new capabilities in employee engagement and HR talent and advisory with the acquisitions of several Aon business units (now known as Kincentric, a Spencer Stuart Company) and Cambria Consulting.
* Our commitment to supporting leaders and to accelerating client performance. In 2021, we made an initial investment in Meyler Campbell, a firm that provides executive coach training and leadership development services. In 2025, we have successfully completed the acquisition, and Meyler Campbell is now fully part of the Spencer Stuart family.

**PURPOSE AND IMPACT**


At Spencer Stuart, we discover and develop leadership for a better future. As leadership consultants, we understand that outstanding leaders drive business performance while also impacting long\-term sustainability, equity, and inclusion.


Through our portfolio of services, we help our clients find solutions to address evolving leadership needs at a global scale. Our team members have expertise spanning senior\-level executive search, board recruitment and effectiveness, CEO succession and development, top team acceleration, culture shaping, and post\-merger talent integration.


**KEY SPENCER STUART INDIA (Pvt.) Ltd. FACTS**

* Spencer Stuart has had a presence in India since 2006
* Total Team of 75\+ people
* Relatively young team with global exposure
* Great mix of management consulting and industry leadership backgrounds
* 3 office locations: Mumbai, Gurgaon and Bangalore
* Proven track record across all sectors and functions

**CULTURE**


Equally dedicated to driving results for clients and caring for our team, we pride ourselves on fostering a special culture, one where relationships, insight, excellence, curiosity, global spirit and humour are highly valued. Our brand, reputation, professional platform and career trajectory are incredibly compelling for talented individuals who desire to grow and develop in a distinguished professional\-services firm.


For more information visit: www.spencerstuart.com

**Position Summary**

**THE ROLE**


The Client Development Analyst (CDA) will be responsible for support of varied client development and business generation projects for the Asia Pacific region, with a particular focus on India. Working closely with consultants, senior associates and associates across all sectors and functions across Asia Pacific, the Analyst will develop bespoke capabilities documents (quals), perform in\-depth research, prepare original analysis and insights, handle other assignments as directed and ensure content is adequately and regularly stored and distributed to relevant audiences. Over time, it is expected that the Analyst will develop expertise in tracking industry, leadership and broader talent trends.


This role will be based in any one of our offices in India while interacting with the APAC region.

**KEY RELATIONSHIPS**

**Reports to**


Client Development Director, Asia Pacific

**Other key relationships**


Asia Pacific Industry and Functional Practice Leaders


Consultants, Associates, Senior Associates, Executive Assistants


Client Development Managers and Analysts (Singapore, Amsterdam and Chicago)

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


The analyst will focus on the following:

**Client material and insights** **development**

* Create tailored client\-facing materials and internal business development materials, based on a solid understanding of the potential client/client’s industry, including specific information regarding the “value proposition” (strategy, competitive landscape, culture insights, etc.).
* Synthesize information accurately and effectively to translate complex inputs into clear, client\-ready PowerPoint presentations and other supporting materials.
* Liaise with consultants and client development team while developing business development and client facing materials across all stages of prospecting – from new leads to competitive presentations, while ensuring consistency of content across geographies, industries, and functions in the firm.
* Draft storylines and narratives which underscore the firm’s ability to serve new and prospective clients and to deliver excellence.

**Content management**

* Respond to content queries received from consultants and teams and deliver resources that prepare them for success.
* Take ownership for the team’s content management. Help maintain tools and systems to assist in centralizing and organizing business development materials, including standardized and/or tailored presentations, developing templates, and the like.
* Provide administrative and communications support, including proofing, formatting and content revisions for internal and external reporting and communications.

**Growth and strategy support**

* Participate and contribute as needed to internal practice calls, including pulling financial updates and other insights with the guidance of the Client Development Manager and the regional Practice Leaders.
* Develop and enhance relationships with key stakeholders and collaborative partners across the firm.
* Contribute to practice and firm\-wide initiatives, communications, and strategic projects.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


Successful candidates will be self\-directed, collaborative, team\-spirited, comfortable with ambiguity, highly organized, detail\-oriented and demonstrate strong project management skills. They have an aptitude and enjoyment of PowerPoint and other forms of content creation. They also demonstrate curiosity and a desire to grow their industry(s) and business knowledge.


In addition, they will demonstrate passion and ability for working with people, communicating clearly, approaching challenges with maturity and a positive attitude, and collaborating within a global team to drive greater business performance. They will be graceful under pressure, enjoy fast\-paced environments, and be excellent multitaskers to partner directly with our consultants and associates across the Asia Pacific region, with a particular focus in India.


Finally, successful candidates will demonstrate business acumen and good problem\-solving skills.

**Work Experience**


Minimal 1\-2 years of internship or full\-time experience in an international corporate environment, ideally at a professional services or consulting firm.

**Tools**


Proficiency with MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, and Word), with ability to create sharp and thoughtfully designed client\-ready presentations in PowerPoint. Has experience contributing to major research efforts that include analyses of business and industry trends.


Experience with collecting and organizing information from databases and/or internet resources. Ability to analyze and synthesize data into other formats. Familiar with business reference resources such as Capital IQ, LinkedIn, BoardEx etc.

**Education**


An undergraduate/Bachelor’s degree is mandatory.

**CRITICAL CAPABILITIES FOR SUCCESS**


1\. **Organizational and project management abilities:** High attention to detail and strong organizational skills to manage multiple projects under a tight deadline, ensuring all business development materials are accurate, accessible, and well\-structured.


2\. **Problem\-solving and analytical skills:** Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities to ask insightful questions, leverage appropriate resources efficiently, and apply business and industry context to derive relevant, high\-quality insights from data.


3\. **Confident communication with a strong collaborative mindset:** Skilled at engaging senior stakeholders regularly and building effective relationships, while working collaboratively with cross\-functional teams to drive business growth and elevate client satisfaction.


4\. **Ownership and adaptability****:** Consistent accountability and follow\-through, prioritizing effectively and delivering high\-quality work while navigating ambiguity, limited information, and tight timelines.


5\. **Learning mindset and feedback orientation**: Openness to feedback, applies learnings quickly, and invests in ongoing development to enhance quality and effectiveness.

We are looking for an experienced, compassionate, and highly organized HR Manager who can build and strengthen our people practices while ensuring that our culture remains aligned with our mission and values.

**Position Summary:**

The HR Manager will lead all human resources functions across the organization, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, compliance, payroll coordination, learning \& development, HR operations, and organizational culture.

This role requires someone who can balance empathy with accountability while supporting both operational excellence and employee wellbeing.

**Employee Relations**

* Address employee grievances.

* Resolve workplace conflicts professionally.
* Ensure fairness and confidentiality.
* Conduct employee engagement initiatives.

**Compliance**

**Training \& Development**

* Maintain training records.

**Organizational Development**

* Improve employee retention strategies.

**HR Administration**

* Prepare employment verification letters.
* Issue experience letters.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field.
* MBA in Human Resources preferred.

**Experience:**

* 5–8 years of progressive HR experience.
* Minimum 2 years managing HR operations independently.

title: Manager Engineering
description:
Paylocity is an award\-winning provider of cloud\-based HR and payroll software solutions, offering the most complete platform for the modern workforce. The company has become one of the fastest\-growing HCM software providers worldwide by offering an intuitive, easy\-to\-use product suite that helps businesses automate and streamline HR and payroll processes, attract and retain talent, and build a strong workplace culture.


While traditional HR and payroll providers automate basic HR processes such as payroll and benefits administration, Paylocity goes further by developing tools that HR and businesses need to compete for talent and deliver against the expectations of the modern workforce.


Paylocity acquired Airbase! Airbase Inc., a modern finance and spend management software solution that combines bill pay / accounts payable automation, expense management, corporate cards and procurement capabilities. The acquisition of Airbase represents an expansion of Paylocity’s suite and is expected to deliver incremental integrated value to HR and finance leaders in managing all of their spend on a single platform – expanding the Paylocity total addressable market beyond HCM and further into the Office of the CFO.


We give our employees what they need to succeed, including great benefits and perks! We offer various benefits, as well as perks that support you, your family, and your finances. And if it’s career development you desire, we provide that, too! At **Airbase by Paylocity**, people matter most and have always been at the heart of our business.


Help **Airbase by Paylocity** enhance communication and enable employees to connect, collaborate, and create from anywhere with a position in Product \& Technology! Want to develop the strategies and principles needed to deliver compelling software? Join our team and help us enhance our all\-in\-one software platform, elevate our one\-of\-a\-kind technology, and improve the employee experience.


Take your career to the next level at one of G2's Top 100 Software Companies. Explore our Product \& Technology positions to see where you fit!

**Position Overview**


This role manages a team of software engineers responsible for building and evolving an AI platform that will be leveraged across the company's product suite to accelerate innovation and deliver intelligent, AI\-powered experiences for customers. You will be responsible for the technical execution, operational efficiency, and overall health of the team's engineering output, ensuring the delivery of secure, scalable, and high\-quality software solutions. As an engineering leader, you will partner closely with our Product teams to define and execute the technical strategy for AI platform capabilities, cloud infrastructure, and developer\-facing services. You will foster a high\-performing, collaborative team environment, mentor engineers, and drive continuous improvements in engineering practices, product quality, and delivery effectiveness. This role requires strong technical leadership, a hands\-on approach to problem\-solving, and the ability to navigate emerging technologies in the rapidly evolving AI landscape. Success in this role requires building strong partnerships with engineering and product teams across both the United States and the Czech Republic, ensuring effective cross\-functional and cross\-geography collaboration while delivering impactful platform capabilities that can be adopted throughout the organization.

**Primary Responsibilities**


The below represents the primary duties of the position, others may be assigned as needed. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


* Lead and manage an engineering team, ensuring alignment with product and business goals.
* Own the overall health, scalability, and quality of products within the team’s domain.
* Drive technical execution and delivery of high\-quality, scalable software solutions.
* Empower and unblock the team by establishing efficient execution and operational processes, ensuring high velocity and impactful delivery.
* Facilitate and continuously improve team processes, including development, planning, oncall rotations, bug triage, and metrics review.
* Drive execution on projects/goals that may extend beyond the immediate team’s scope, ensuring cross\-functional collaboration.
* Coach and mentor engineers, supporting their career growth and skill development.
* Work with a single team and product partners within a domain that may contain multiple products or applications while managing dependencies and expected outcomes.
* Collaborate with Product, Security, and Business teams to align technical strategy with company objectives.
* Ensure adherence to security best practices and compliance standards.
* Monitor and analyze team performance metrics to drive continuous improvements in quality, velocity, and efficiency.
* Manage team capacity and resource planning, ensuring the right talent is allocated to meet project goals.
* Stay up to date on industry trends and emerging technologies, applying relevant innovations to enhance team effectiveness.

**Education and Experience**

* BS degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, with 1\+ years in a management role.
* Strong hands\-on technical background in software development, including experience building and maintaining applications using .NET and C\#.
* Hands\-on experience designing, developing, and operating cloud\-based solutions in AWS, with a solid understanding of modern cloud architecture, scalability, security, and operational best practices.
* Experience building applications that leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, including integrating AI services, large language models (LLMs), machine learning capabilities, or other intelligent features into customer\-facing or internal applications.
* Experience working in agile development environments and driving process improvements.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high\-performing engineering teams.
* Strong collaboration skills, with experience working across Product, Design, and Business functions.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, adaptability to change, and a curious, growth\-oriented mindset.

**Physical requirements**

* Ability to sit for extended periods: The role requires sitting at a desk or workstation for long periods, typically 7\-8 hours a day.
* Use of computer and phone systems: The employee must be able to operate a computer, use phone systems, and type. This includes using multiple software programs and inquiries simultaneously.

title: HR Business Partner - APAC
description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

  

The Human Resources Business Partner – APAC will serve as a hands\-on HR partner supporting leadership teams across mainly India and Australia, responsible for end\-to\-end HR support while strengthening talent management practices.

  

Reporting directly to the Global Chief People Officer of DeepHealth, this role will operate as part of the global HR leadership structure, partnering closely with regional HR Operation manager and business leaders to ensure alignment of talent strategy, performance discipline, and governance standards across regions.

  

The role requires a pragmatic HR leader who can operate both strategically and operationally, with the ability to execute independently in a global matrix environment.

  

This position is primarily an HRBP role with additional responsibility for talent management, including performance discipline, manager capability, and development planning. The individual will strengthen talent attraction, mid\-career development, high\-potential identification, structured career pathing, and succession sequencing while ensuring disciplined implementation of enterprise HR frameworks.

  

The role requires a pragmatic HR leader who can operate hands\-on, provide clear guidance to leaders, and execute talent and people initiatives in a global matrix environment.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**HR Business Partnering**

* Partner with business leaders to understand organizational needs and provide clear, actionable HR guidance aligned with business priorities.
* Design, adapt and implement workforce strategy into practical organizational actions, supporting leadership teams on organizational design, talent planning, and capability development.
* Serve as the primary HRBP for India, supporting leaders on employee relations, performance management, compensation decisions, organizational design, and workforce planning.
* Provide hands\-on execution across the employee lifecycle, including hiring support, onboarding, performance documentation, and offboarding.

**Talent Management \& Development**

* Design and implement structured career frameworks, competency models, and progression standards for technical and mid\-career talent.
* Support leadership teams in developing stronger manager capability for coaching, performance feedback and management, and career development of technical professionals.
* Lead and execute talent reviews, succession planning processes, and high\-potential identification with measurable follow\-through.
* Strengthen compensation governance and promotion sequencing to ensure disciplined and equitable talent decisions.
* Build retention strategies informed by workforce analytics, engagement trends, and attrition insights.
* Assess external talent ecosystems, including university pipelines, industry talent networks, and potential partner organizations, to strengthen long\-term talent attraction strategy.

**Local Company Culture \& Office Life**

* Champion and embed company culture across the India and APAC offices, acting as a visible culture carrier and trusted resource for employees and managers alike.
* Oversee and coordinate office management in Bangalore, ensuring a well\-functioning, inclusive, and engaging workplace environment that reflects the company’s values and supports day\-to\-day operations.
* Promote collaborative ways of working across the APAC region, fostering cross\-site connection, knowledge sharing, and a unified team culture spanning India and Australia.

**Learning \& Development**

* Oversee the rollout and completion of mandatory training programs, including Quality, Regulatory, and Compliance (QRC) courses, ensuring full regional adherence and accurate tracking.
* Coordinate functional and technology training initiatives, partnering with business and technical leaders to identify skill gaps and deploy targeted development programs for technical and mid\-career professionals.
* Drive social and interpersonal skills development across the region, facilitating programs focused on communication, collaboration, leadership presence, and stakeholder management to strengthen team effectiveness.

**HR Governance \& Compliance with HR Operations**

* Define and operationalize employment and compensation governance frameworks to ensure consistency, scalability, and regulatory alignment.
* Monitor workforce metrics including retention, engagement, mobility, and promotion velocity, providing data\-driven recommendations to leadership.
* Align regional employment practices with Indian labor regulations and global HR governance standards, in partnership with HR Operations and Legal.

**Talent Acquisition \& Recruiting**

* Elevate recruiting discipline and talent acquisition quality, including direct sourcing for hard\-to\-fill roles; demonstrated hands\-on proficiency using LinkedIn Recruiter and Boolean search is required.
* Define and institutionalize candidate evaluation standards, pipeline strategy, and onboarding quality frameworks to improve hiring effectiveness.

**Global Collaboration \& Alignment**

* Collaborate with global HR leadership to implement enterprise talent initiatives locally and contribute to broader talent framework development.
* Collaborate closely with regional HR partners and business leaders to ensure alignment of talent strategy and people priorities across regions.
* Operate effectively in a global matrix environment, aligning with centralized HR governance and global practices.

*PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.*

 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS, EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* 10\+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, with significant experience operating as a hands\-on HR Business Partner in India
* Demonstrated experience partnering directly with senior business leaders and owning HR outcomes end\-to\-end
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and employment practices, with experience managing complex employee relations matters independently
* Demonstrated experience supporting recruiting efforts, including direct sourcing using LinkedIn Recruiter and partnership with hiring managers on difficult\-to\-fill roles
* Experience supporting performance management cycles, including calibration discussions, performance documentation, and manager coaching
* Exposure to compensation governance, including leveling, internal equity considerations, and promotion decisions
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization with alignment to centralized HR governance
* Strong verbal communication skills with ability to communicate clearly and concisely with business leaders
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field

 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience supporting technical, product, or R\&D teams
* Experience working in a distributed APAC environment
* Experience operating in a scaling or high\-growth organization
* Demonstrated experience driving talent management initiatives such as succession discussions, development planning, and manager capability

**QUALITY STANDARDS**

* Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co\-workers, visitors, and vendors.
* Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.
* Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.
* Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.
* Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.
* Practices universal safety precautions.
* Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.
* Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.
* Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.
* Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

**Travel**


This position requires periodic domestic / international travel.

 **Working Environment**


Hybrid role based in Bangalore, India.

description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Job Description**


We are looking for a VP of People Solutions Team to provide leadership and support to advance our exciting journey of transformation to design and execute on best\-in\-class People strategies, systems and structures that drive successful outcomes across all facets of Visa’s Go\-to\-Market activities.


The VP People Solutions will possess outstanding leadership, strong relationship building skills, execution focus, proven problem\-solving skills and will be proactive, agile, able to define strategy and translate it into actions and able to inspire and motivate teams through change and transformation.


The role needs a leader that drives accountability, and someone with a successful track record in process transformation. This position will lead from the front and achieve results side\-by\-side with our transformation and accelerator teams.


The main responsibility of the Vice President, People Solutions is to lead Visa’s People Solutions (HR Shared Services) function and transform our solutions delivery team into a world class solutions organization that delivers value to Visa through an integrated shared services environment, globally.


This role manages teams across multiple regions, collaborating with People Centers of Excellence (COEs) \& People Business Partner (PBP) communities, technology teams and other Visa groups to develop and execute strategic and operational service delivery plans.


This leader will also work with leadership to drive service excellence, innovative solutions and the transformation of our overall People Solutions support model, expanding the services provided by our organization to provide a more holistic employee experience and enable our PBPs and People COEs to focus on driving our strategic talent agenda. This will entail designing and implementing an enhanced shared services delivery model, onboarding of new internal teams into the People Solutions organization and partnership with Visa teams in enabling greater self\-service, process reengineering, process harmonization, and organization design.


The role reports to the SVP, Head of People Systems and Operations and will be a key member of the Global Enterprise Transformation and Solutions team.

**Essential Functions:**

* Foster a client\-focused environment and mindset to ensure delivery of an exceptional employee experience
* Lead a team of seasoned strategic leaders and subject matter experts responsible for providing innovative world\-class People support to Visa people globally
* Lead the People Solutions Transformation – a large, global project with impacts across the People function. Serve as the overall project leader, driving the integration across 3 key workstreams and their associated leaders:
* People Systems – Identify and implement an integrated tech solution to leverage emerging technologies to drive self\-service, increase speed and accuracy of resolution, and reduce ticket volume
* People Solutions Evolution – Expand the scope of support provided by the People Solutions team to handle a greater number of employee inquiries and perform operational People tasks
* Manager Consultation – Establish a new team dedicated to providing People generalist support to front\-line managers
* Design the People Solutions function of the future, including the following goals:
* a. Deflection of 45% of current case volume via self\-service
* b. 80% of cases accurately and fully resolved upon first contact
* c. Average case resolution time of less than 2 business days
* + Build the resource plan to support the future People Solutions vision, balancing the efficiencies of a centralized hub with the local knowledge required to provide effective support. Determine the right resource mix and locations for a “hub\-and\-spoke” model.
* Develop the framework for identifying and evaluating work that can transition to People Solutions, oversee comprehensive process documentation, and ensure the team has the right skills, knowledge, mindsets, behaviors and capability to deliver.
* Build an effective quality assurance program and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Develop deep partnerships with Regional and Functional PBPs and COE leaders.
* Develop comprehensive operational plans and strategy to support business growth and maintain optimal volume throughput, cost control, operations efficiency, and quality.
* Implement uniform best practices while maintaining compliance.
* Systematically cultivate and maintain collaborative relationships with managers of the organization to achieve mutual goals.
* Maintain and foster a high level of teamwork, hire and mentor best in class.
* Develop and implement plans and research projects to improve and expand operational growth and financial profitability.
* Oversee and adjust processes and operations as necessary to ensure efficient and effective execution of policies and procedures.
* This leader will drive a mindset of continuous improvement and customer service to support the ease of the experience and operational effectiveness


This is a hybrid position. Hybrid employees can alternate time between both remote and office. Employees in hybrid roles are expected to work from the office 2\-3 set days a week (determined by leadership/site), with a general guidepost of being in the office 50% or more of the time based on business needs.

description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Job Summary
  

  

The Talent Acquisition Associate at Jabil, Inc. supports the recruitment team in attracting, sourcing, and onboarding top talent. This role is crucial for maintaining a robust candidate pipeline and ensuring a positive candidate experience.
  

  

Job Responsibilities
  

  

* Assist recruiters with various stages of the recruitment process, including sourcing, screening, and scheduling interviews.
* Utilize Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruitment software to manage candidate data and workflows.

* Maintain and update candidate records and recruitment metrics for reporting purposes.
* Coordinate interview logistics, including sending invitations, confirming attendance, and reserving meeting rooms.
* Support the onboarding process for new hires, including preparing offer letters and managing pre\-employment checks.

* Respond to candidate inquiries and provide a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

* Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and HRIS platforms.
* Strong organizational skills with a keen attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.

* High degree of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
