**About The Role**
 We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant to build and lead the finance function of a fast\-growing, YC\-backed AI education startup.
   

  

**Role**
 This is not a conventional accounting role. You will work closely with the founders and take ownership across three interconnected areas:
   

  

* Finance and business reporting
* People and workplace operations


 The objective is to create reliable systems across these functions so that the founders can focus on product, growth and company\-building without having to repeatedly follow up on operational matters.
   

  

 As the company grows, this role can develop into a broader finance leadership and CFO\-track position.
   

  

 What You Will Own
   

  

* Finance and Reporting


 You will take end\-to\-end ownership of the company’s finance operations, including:
   

  

 — Monthly closing, financial reporting and management MIS
   

  

 — Profit and loss, cash\-flow and balance\-sheet visibility
   

  

 — Budgeting, forecasting and financial planning
   

  

 — Accounting processes, reconciliations and payment operations
   

  

 — Taxation, audits and statutory compliance
   

  

 — Payroll, reimbursements and vendor payments
   

  

 — Revenue, payment\-gateway and customer\-invoice reconciliation
   

  

 — Financial controls and documentation
   

  

 — Coordination across Indian and international entities
   

  

 You will be expected to improve existing processes and gradually build a finance function that is accurate, automated and scalable.
   

  

* Financial Planning and Treasury


 You will help the founders make better financial decisions by managing:
   

  

 — Cash\-flow planning and runway visibility
   

  

 — Budget versus actual reporting
   

  

 — Cost and subscription tracking
   

  

 — Banking relationships and banking operations
   

  

 — Fixed deposits and short\-term deployment of surplus funds
   

  

 — Company credit cards, debit cards and payment controls
   

  

 — Intercompany fund movements and related documentation
   

  

 — Automation of recurring banking and finance workflows
   

  

* Investor, Cap Table and ESOP Operations


**You Will Coordinate Finance\-related Investor And Ownership Matters, Including**
 — Maintaining the company’s cap table
   

  

 — Supporting share issuances and related documentation
   

  

 — Preparing information required for investor reporting and due diligence
   

  

 — Coordinating with external advisers during fundraising
   

  

 — Maintaining ESOP records and supporting ESOP grants
   

  

 — Handling ESOP\-related communication with current and former employees
   

  

 — Helping improve and administer the company’s ESOP policy
   

  

 You will not be expected to personally provide specialised legal advice. However, you should be able to coordinate external lawyers, company secretaries, auditors and consultants and ensure that work is completed accurately and on time.
   

  

* People Operations


 Since we will not have a separate full\-time HR team, you will also own essential employee operations, supported by the founders and external HR or legal partners where required.
   

  

**This Will Include**
 — Employee and intern onboarding
   

  

 — Employment documentation and joining formalities
   

  

 — Payroll coordination and employee records
   

  

 — Leave and probation records
   

  

 — Employee benefits administration
   

  

 — Offboarding and full\-and\-final coordination
   

  

**— Experience, Relieving And Other Employment Certificates**
 — Maintaining salary, ESOP and employee documentation
   

  

 — Communicating and maintaining internal policies
   

  

 — Coordinating employee\-related operational queries
   

  

 The objective is not to function as a traditional recruiter or culture manager. The role is to ensure that every employee has a professional and well\-managed experience from joining to exit.
   

  

* Workplace and Asset Management


 You will ensure that company\-owned resources are properly managed, including:
   

  

 — Laptop, device and SIM allocation records
   

  

 — Device handovers during onboarding and offboarding
   

  

 — Company asset tracking
   

  

 — SIM, subscription and recurring bill management
   

  

 — Coordination of device transfers, repairs and replacements
   

  

 — Maintaining clear accountability for company\-owned equipment
   

  

* Founder’s Office and Special Projects


 You will act as a trusted member of the Founder’s Office and help execute important matters that do not neatly belong to one department.
   

  

**This May Include**
 — Managing sensitive follow\-ups across internal and external stakeholders
   

  

 — Supporting investor, partner and leadership visits
   

  

 — Ensuring meetings, documents and visit logistics are professionally managed
   

  

 — Supporting high\-priority documentation
   

  

 — Representing the founders in operational follow\-ups where appropriate
   

  

 — Making sure important tasks do not fall through the cracks
   

  

 The role will provide visibility into how an early\-stage company is built and scaled. You will work directly with the founders on decisions that span finance, people, operations and company strategy.
   

  

 Who We Are Looking For
   

  

**You Should Be**
 — A qualified Chartered Accountant
   

  

 — Experienced in Accounting, FP\&A, Reporting, Audit and Taxation
   

  

 — Someone with approximately 2–3 years of relevant professional experience
   

  

 — Comfortable setting up processes rather than only operating established systems
   

  

 — Highly organised and dependable
   

  

 — Strong at written and verbal communication
   

  

 — Comfortable working directly with founders, investors and external professionals
   

  

 — Willing to remain hands\-on while also building systems and leading execution
   

  

 — Capable of handling confidential financial and employee information
   

  

 — Comfortable working full\-time from our HSR Layout office
   

  

 Articleship experience at a Big Four firm or professional experience at a high\-growth startup would be preferred.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

**Within This Role, Success Would Mean**
 — Founders have clear and timely visibility into the company’s financial position
   

  

 — Monthly reporting and closing happen predictably
   

  

 — Cash, investments and banking operations are actively managed
   

  

 — Finance processes become increasingly automated and scalable
   

  

 — Employee onboarding, payroll and offboarding run smoothly
   

  

 — Investor, ESOP and ownership records remain accurate and updated
   

  

 — Important external advisers are coordinated without repeated founder involvement
   

  

 — Sensitive operational matters are handled with maturity and discretion
   

  

 — Founders can rely on one accountable person to drive important cross\-functional work
   

  

 Why This Role Is Exciting
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of finance, people and company\-building (if you are interested in startups, this is for you)
   

  

 You will not be limited to preparing reports or managing compliance. You will help build the internal operating system of a growing startup, work closely with its founders and gain exposure to fundraising, financial planning, people operations, cross\-border structures and strategic company decisions.
   

  

 For the right person, this role has the potential to grow into a senior finance leadership or CFO\-track position as the organisation scales.

title: Crew Management Partner
description:
**Vacancy No**

 VN15982  

**Employment Type**

 Permanent  

**Location Country**

 India  

**Work Location**

 Mumbai  

**Who are V?**

 As a global leader in ship management and marine services, we add value to a vessel’s operations. Operating around the clock and around the world, V. gives every client the quality and efficiency they need in every sector. Covering crew management and recruitment, quality ship management and technical services, together with supporting management and commercial services, V. has an unrivalled industry knowledge with performance assured. Our values, We Care, We Collaborate, We Challenge, We are Consistent, We Commit and Deliver, are at the heart of everything we do and they support our strategy of Investing in Talent. We are always interested in making contact with talented individuals \- people who will demonstrate our values and deliver great service, for internal and external stakeholders.  

**Overall Purpose of The Job**

* The role ensures compliance with customer agreements, budget ownership, workforce planning, engagement, crew retention, and service delivery. This position acts as the primary interface between Seafarer, Fleet Management, Crewing Operations, and external stakeholders, ensuring execution of crew\-related activities.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities and Tasks**

**Crew Management \& Service Delivery**
* Ensures all duties and responsibilities are carried out in accordance with VMS, national and international statutory requirements.
* Works closely with the Fleet Cell and Marine HR to ensure service delivery as per customer contracts.
* Functions as the escalation point for all crew\-related matters, collaborating with Fleet Managers and Crewing Operations to resolve issues.
* Ensures that Crew Management delivers on KPIs agreed upon between client, Fleet Cells, and Crew Management, including budget ownership for crew operations.
* Ensures the diligent usage of ShipSure as the system of record for all crewing activities and drives it with other teams for their crew and vessels.


**Crew Planning \& Workforce Management**
* Responsible for crew engagement and crew welfare.
* Maintains an effective crew rotation plan for assigned vessels, ensuring consistency with global planning principles and as guided by Global Pool Managers.
* Identifies candidates for vacancies using fleet crew pools and recruitment when needed. Escalates critical vacancies to RCMP and Global Pool Manager when necessary.
* Works proactively and as guided by the Global Pool Manager to maintain and balance crew pool strength, including managing crew surpluses and reallocations.
* Supports fleet takeovers by identifying suitable seafarers for vessel transition.
* Works closely with the Global Pool Manager and supports building career progression plans for seafarers and ensures performance monitoring through appraisals.
* Identifies and addresses crew retention risks by working with key stakeholders


**Budget Management \& Operational Efficiency**
* Owns and manages the Vessel budget, including annual renewals, negotiation with customers and reporting.
* Owns and manage budget preparation by providing insights on wages, benefits, and crewing costs in collaboration with the P\&L team.
* Schedules and reports on service performance and budget reviews, recommending actions to support continuous improvement.


**Compliance, Industrial Relations \& HSSEQ Support**
* Ensures compliance with maritime regulations, flag state requirements, and industrial relations for assigned fleets.
* Manages urgent crew changes and vacancies through the effective utilization of the V.Ships seafarer pool.
* Assists HSSEQ in accident investigations related to crewing and supports the implementation of corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive data quality and comply with Quality Assurance process (Audit)


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Process Improvement**
* Participate in the new business proposal preparation and review as well as new business onboarding process.
* Collaborates proactively with internal and external stakeholders, including seafarers to ensure outstanding service delivery.
* Be familiar with and promote V.Group and Marine HR services and initiatives.
* Provides feedback on ShipSure enhancements and other crewing process improvements.
* Works digitally with V.Crew Connect, ShipSure BI, and other digital tools to streamline operations.
* Delivers client reports, ensuring transparency and data\-driven insights into seafarer management and operational performance.
  

  

**What can I expect in return?**

 V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector \- a company that has exciting plans for future growth.  

**Essential**

* Maritime or shipping industry experience
* Knowledge of crew operations, planning, and workforce management.
* Proven customer service mindset and ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills to drive change and improvement.
* Ability to manage budgets, reports, and performance KPIs effectively.
* Excellent communication skills, with an ability to negotiate and resolve conflicts effectively.
* Good technology and data analysis proficiency.
  

  

**Desirable**

* Proficiency in ShipSure and planning tools functionality.
* Multinational work experience
  

  

**Applications Close Date**

description:

----------------------------------------------------------------------------


You will play a pivotal role in hiring talent by supporting TA Specialists throughout the hiring process, with a special focus on sourcing and screening through various platforms, and ensuring a superior candidate experience across all hiring stages.  

  



**What You'll do**
------------------


* Partner with Talent Acquisition Business Partners and business leaders to understand sales hiring requirements and build targeted sourcing strategies aligned with business needs.
* Proactively source high\-quality sales talent through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, social platforms, talent communities, and other innovative sourcing channels.
* Conduct market mapping and competitor research to identify target companies, talent pools, and passive candidates for current and future hiring needs.
* Build and maintain robust talent pipelines for volume and niche sales roles, ensuring a continuous flow of qualified candidates.
* Screen and assess candidate profiles against role requirements, motivation, and cultural fit before sharing shortlisted talent with hiring managers.
* Support sales hiring campaigns and recruitment drives,
* Maintain accurate candidate records, sourcing metrics, and market intelligence to continuously improve sourcing effectiveness and hiring outcomes.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Minimum 3 years of experience
* Preferably an MBA in HR
* Proven track record in talent acquisition, with hands\-on experience using various sourcing techniques and tools, with a particular focus on leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter.
* Outstanding communication skills, ability to coach candidates and hiring managers towards finding the best talent for Hilti

Known for our focus on providing fulfilling careers and a culture of Performance with Care, we are Ranked 19th amongst India’s Best Workplaces and 4th Among Asia’s Best Workplaces by Great Place to Work Institute® . Since 2013, we have been connecting chemical manufacturers with customers worldwide through our expertise in international sourcing, supply chain management, logistics, and business development.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for a highly motivated and experienced **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to join our team at our Noida office.

title: Design Executive
description:
**About the Role**

**Homedge Interior Pvt. Ltd.** is a premium interior solutions and furniture brand offering modular furniture, loose furniture, and end\-to\-end turnkey interior projects to retail and B2B clients.

As we scale our operations across regions, we are **looking for a creative, technically proficient, and client\-savvy Design Executive** to join our growing team.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Job Overview**

The Design Executive is **responsible for** **understanding client requirements** for modular furniture, conducting accurate site measurements, preparing design estimations and costings, and ensuring smooth coordination between design, production, and installation teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Product Designing**

* Develop new modular furniture concepts and product designs aligned with client requirements and market trends.
* Create innovative, practical, and aesthetically refined design solutions for residential and commercial projects.
* Support continuous improvement and enhancement of Homedge's product design offerings.

**2\. Technical Software — AutoCAD, SketchUp \& Rendering**

* Prepare detailed 2D production drawings and layouts using AutoCAD for all assigned projects.
* Develop accurate 3D models and visualisations using SketchUp to communicate design intent to clients and production teams.
* Create high\-quality rendered visuals using rendering tools (Enscape / V\-Ray / similar) for client presentations and approvals.
* Maintain drawing version control and ensure latest approved drawings are always on record.

**3\. Estimation \& Costing**

* Prepare accurate design\-based cost estimates for modular furniture requirements across all assigned projects.
* Evaluate material requirements, hardware specifications, finishes, and accessories for cost calculation.
* Ensure estimation accuracy and consistency — minimising variance between estimated and actual project costs.
* Prepare BOQ for quantity validation and commercial alignment before client submission.

**4\. Site Measurement \& Survey**

* Visit client locations to conduct precise site measurements for modular furniture requirements.
* Record dimensions, site conditions, and constraints for accurate production and execution reference.
* Ensure measurement accuracy to eliminate production and installation deviations.

**5\. Design \& Production Coordination**

* Coordinate production and technical drawings with the design and production teams.
* Review drawings and identify technical inconsistencies or design discrepancies before production release.
* Support smooth conversion of approved designs into production\-ready execution documentation.

**6\. On\-Site Installation \& Issue Resolution**

* Coordinate with architects and site stakeholders during furniture installation phases.
* Visit project sites to resolve technical concerns, product doubts, and installation\-related issues.
* Provide timely, practical support for execution challenges on\-site.

**7\. Material Inspection**

* Conduct technical inspection and sorting of modular furniture materials before production and installation.
* Verify quality standards and specification compliance at every stage.
* Report quality concerns and coordinate corrective action where required.

**8\. BOQ Preparation \& Purchase Order Follow\-up**

* Preparation of Bill of Quantities post client confirmation.
* Preparation and processing of Purchase Orders for all assigned projects.
* Follow up on material procurement, vendor timelines, and production execution schedules.

**9\. Client \& Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with Sales Head, Purchase Manager, architects, and external agencies on technical and design matters.
* Provide regular client updates on material status, furniture production, and new product development.
* Ensure timely, professional resolution of client queries and concerns.

**10\. Revisions \& Documentation**

* Carry out design revisions based on client feedback and project requirements.
* Maintain technical documentation, version control, and design approval records.
* Evaluate manufacturing feasibility before final design sign\-off.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

title: Data Analyst (Junior level) – (6 months-4 years)
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a bright and eager Junior Azure Data Analyst to join our data team in Chennai. This role is ideal for a recent graduate or an early\-career professional with 0\-3 years of experience and a solid understanding of database concepts and ETL processes, particularly within the Microsoft ecosystem. You will provide technical assistance for our data and analytics products, which are built on Microsoft technologies. Additionally, you will assist in transforming data into valuable insights using your analytical abilities, familiarity with Azure data services, and proficiency in SQL, Python. This entry\-level role requires a foundational understanding of databases (MS SQL preferred), data concepts, and basic analytical skills. You will utilize your SQL knowledge to investigate data\-related issues and your communication skills to support our users effectively. This is an excellent opportunity to begin a career in product support with a focus on data and analytics.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Assist in developing and maintaining data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, SSIS, or custom Python scripts.
* Perform data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) between on\-premises and cloud sources (e.g., MS SQL Server, Azure Blob Storage).
* Help monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot failures, and ensure timely data availability.
* Support database operations including backup/restore, health checks, and schema documentation.
* Use SQL to query and manipulate data from Microsoft SQL Server and Azure\-based data stores.
* Develop basic reports and dashboards using Power BI, under the guidance of senior team members.
* Contribute to the design and upkeep of data models within the Azure environment.
* Document data processes and reporting solutions for internal use.
* Configure / manage monitoring tools like Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
* Analyse logs and telemetry data to detect performance issues and system trends.
* Participating in incident response and root cause analysis for data and infrastructure disruptions.
* Provide first\-line technical support for data and analytics products across communication channels.
* Investigate user\-reported issues using SQL queries to identify and resolve data\-related problems.
* Clearly document the support interactions, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions.
* Maintain clear and concise documentation for solutions, pipelines, and monitoring standards.
* Share best practices and contribute to knowledge bases to support team learning and operational efficiency.
* Work closely with senior analysts and engineers to understand business requirements and contribute to data\-driven solutions.
* Communicate findings and progress effectively within the team.
* Continuously upskill in Azure data services, ETL tools, and analytical techniques.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 6 months – 4 years of relevant experience in cloud monitoring, ETL, or data engineering.
* Familiarity with:
+ Azure Data Factory, Azure Monitor, and Azure SQL Database
+ SQL Server (T\-SQL) and basic Python scripting

* Good understanding of data flow concepts and monitoring needs in production environments.
* Analytical mindset with attention to performance and operational excellence.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field.
* 0\-2 years of relevant experience or strong academic knowledge of database systems and data warehousing concepts.
* Decent understanding of relational databases and the ability to write basic to intermediate SQL queries.
* Familiarity with ETL concepts and ideally some exposure to Azure Data Factory or similar tools.
* Foundational knowledge of Microsoft Azure data services (e.g., Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory).
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Willingness to learn and work collaboratively within a team.

title: Associate BI Reporting Design
description:
Role Summary
   

  

 The Associate – BI Reporting \& Analytics Experience role is an entry\-level position within the Marketing Science Operations (MSO) team. This role is ideal for candidates who are passionate about transforming data into intuitive, visually compelling, and actionable business insights.
   

  

 Beyond traditional reporting, the role focuses on designing user\-centric dashboards, improving stakeholder experience, and leveraging modern analytics technologies to enhance decision\-making. The candidate will work closely with analytics, data engineering, and business teams to build scalable reporting solutions while ensuring data quality, governance, and operational excellence.
   

  

 LIVE \| WHAT YOU WILL DO
   

  

 As an MSO BI Reporting \& Analytics Experience Associate, you will work under the guidance of Senior Associates and Managers to support reporting, dashboard design, data quality operations, and analytics enablement.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, and other visualization platforms.
* Apply visualization and storytelling best practices to create intuitive, user\-friendly analytics experiences.
* Support development of self\-service reporting capabilities that enable faster business decision\-making.
* Assist in data extraction, transformation, and preparation for reporting and analytics use cases.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, and QA checks to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency.
* Monitor data refreshes, reporting completeness, and pipeline health in collaboration with Data Engineering teams.
* Help define and document KPIs, metric definitions, business rules, and reporting standards.
* Identify opportunities to improve dashboard usability, automation, and stakeholder experience.
* Explore emerging technologies, including GenAI\-enabled reporting, natural language querying, automated insight generation, and conversational analytics.
* Support recurring reporting cycles while continuously improving reporting efficiency and scalability.
* Identify data issues, anomalies, or gaps and coordinate resolution with engineering and analytics stakeholders.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's (3–6 years) or Master's (2–4 years) degree in a quantitative discipline such as Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Operations Research, Management Science, Mathematics, or related field.
* Experience developing dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
* Strong understanding of reporting, KPIs, and business metrics.
* Effective oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into reporting and visualization solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with SQL, data preparation, or analytics workflows.
* Understanding of dashboard design principles, data storytelling, and user experience concepts.
* Exposure to Power BI semantic models, Tableau data models, or modern BI architecture.
* Interest in GenAI applications for reporting, automated insights, or conversational analytics.
* Familiarity with data governance, reporting standards, and analytics operations.
* Exposure to DevSecOps, incident management, or reporting production support processes.
* Experience in healthcare, pharma, or regulated environments is a plus.
* Strong curiosity, attention to detail, and passion for creating impactful analytics experiences.

* Strong communication and organizational skills.

* AutoCAD or SolidWorks

* ERP systems
* Lean Manufacturing

* Kaizen
* Root Cause Analysis

What You'll Learn

This role provides exposure to every stage of manufacturing, including:

* Motor design
* Production engineering
* Manufacturing processes
* Testing and validation
* Supply chain
* Quality systems
* Production planning
* Customer product customization

description:

 PedaSys Learning Technology India is an EdTech start\-up focused on transforming how organizations design and deliver learning. title: SCRUM MASTER L1
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
**Role Purpose** 




 As a trained Scrum Master, you are responsible for facilitating a Scrum team and are accountable for removing impediments of the team to achieve the sprint goals/deliverables. You are responsible to ensure that the Scrum process is used as intended. A key part of your role is to protect the development team, allow the teams  to be self managed, foster collaboration across teams and keep them focused on the tasks at hand.
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 



* Is accountable for meeting Sprint objectives along with scrum team
* Ensure meeting of sprint commitment
* Own and help resolve impediments of the team
* Help PO adopt Scrum Process properly and ensure PO availability
* Support the PO in maintaining the Product Backlog, defining User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
* Facilitate estimation, backlog refinement and all planning ceremonies
* Ensure that DOR, DOD, Acceptance criteria is available and adhered to
* Ensure MoSCoW adherence of Sprint Backlog at the Sprint level
* Accountable for the correct implementation of the Agile Process
* Protect the team from external interference.
* Facilitate technical assistance to the team and enables clear communication amongst the team members
* Participate in Scrum of Scrum across teams and highlights impediments
* Provide feedback on the team members performance to the Agile Line manager and Agile Program Leader
* Facilitate all the Scrum Ceremonies (Planning, Daily Standup, Grooming, Demo, restrospection) and ensure correct adoption


 ͏
 * Ensure updating of all Scrum artifacts
* Ensure ALM tool (either client or Wipro) is updated on a daily basis
* Update key Scrum metrics into Wipro internal tool on a Sprint\-by\-Sprint basis
* Analyse key Scrum metrics and take corrective actions
* Create competency improvement and cross\-skilling plan for the team (by the start of the project). Review monthly and ensure improvement in competency score. Ensure multiskilling for at least 50% of the team.
* Help team attain stable velocity within 6\-8 sprints (allowing for 10% variation either way)
* Train team on the proper adoption of Agile processes  (Scrum / XP / Kanban)
* Help in adoption of engineering practices like ATDD, TDD, CI, CD, Refactoring
* Record and own the restrospection actions
* Participate in community of practice initiatives
* Provide inputs to the Line manager for internal quality forums (QIC  / APR / QBR / MBR etc.)


 ͏ ͏
 
 Mandatory Skills: Agile\-Scrum .
 



  
 



 Experience: 5\-8 Years
   

 .

Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

**About The Health Insurance Industry –**
 While the current market sees more than 15 non\-life players in the private space and 5 exclusive private players in the health insurance space trying to capture a sizable market share, the nationalised service provider (6\) remains a strong competitor. In addition to this the business dynamics are such that the overall market on an annual basis which is to the tune of roughly 10,000 Crs sees close to 85 % of the business renewing with the existing service provider itself. This narrows down the opportunity of the fresh business actually being seriously fought in the market to approximately 1500 odd Crs. With the SME and the start\-ups being the driving force of Indian economy, the opportunity to cater to these segments is immense and is increasing manifold year on year. The challenge here therefore remains as to how we capture a larger share of the opportunity by developing specific solutions to cater each segment of the business. Also by creating an inexpensive and standardized solution to increase the reach into the pockets of channel partners across the country to harness on their captive business and explore new opportunities with them.
   

  

 Market Opportunities – With the advent of medical advancements, lifestyle changes, change in Indian socio\-economic scenario and Indian healthcare space, and the insurers are facing challenges to cater to the needs of this diverse clientele. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering health insurance partners as intentions of health advisers. In this scenario it becomes extremely important to understand their psyche and then provide tailored solutions with wellness benefits which would help them meet their end objectives and bring in profitable revenue source for the company.
   

  

**About The Aditya Birla Health Insurance –**
 Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (ABHICL) was incorporated in 2015 as a 51:49 joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) and MMI Strategic Investments (Pty) Ltd. ABHICL commenced its operations in October 2016\.
   

  

 ABHICL has entered the competitive health insurance market with an aim to expand the category to wider customer segments, beyond the ones that health insurance companies traditionally have marketed to. As the 6 th entrant in a category with well\-established players, ABHICL is creating differentiation and equity for itself though the unique business proposition of “Health Insurance for All”, a one of a kind proposition in India at the moment. This is a philosophy that is being built through every single consumer touch point and into every single backend process of the company to ensure a customer’s experience of our proposition is continuous and seamless.
   

  

 ABHI’s unique offering to market includes proposition includes \-
   

  

* A Comprehensive Incentivized Wellness Program that will attract the young and health conscious and will motivate, guide and reward them to stay healthy
* A Chronic Care Management Program to cater to the unmet needs of a growing Indian population of those suffering from chronic lifestyle conditions like Diabetes, Asthma, High Cholesterol and Hypertension from Day 1
* ABHICL serves as an enabler and influencer of health and healthcare choices that customers make, in addition to being a payer of healthcare expenses. Thus, ABHICL would act like a much needed catalyst to grow the prevalent health insurance landscape in India through product innovations and a wider choice of consumer relevant products.
* ABHICL’s vision has always been digital. The company has been successful in adopting paper\-less approach right from identifying to on\-boarding to delivering seamless experience of its customers \& employees.


**Challenges –**
* Though there is a strong association in employees – most of them have running policies from other companies and do not want to port immediately
* The road to customers is often through significant seniors in ABG, who need to understand inherent value proposition before granting access to other employees of organisation
* Since the customers are group employees and their references – any lacunae in service leads to immediate escalations.
* Soft Insurance Market: Considering the soft insurance market in India, offering new\-age solutions to price sensitive clients is difficult. It is extremely important to design and customize the right solution for the right set of clients.
* Upskill the recruited workforce and enable them to do concept selling as against hitherto habit of price based selling.
* Initiatives launched across companies need approvals from Heads in other companies – it is often difficult to secure their time to explain the product offerings and take their approvals to conduct activities.
* The customers often expect customised offerings. Offering and structuring a deal often involves working with various departments like operations, claims, actuarial etc to see what best can be offered. There may be instances that actuarial may not be comfortable offering a particular price that has been made available to the customer and hence working with them to see how best can things be modulated is often a tough ask. Also getting various stakeholders and constituents to the process like operations to understand the sensitivities of the various partners involved and seeing the creation of a process which meets our objective without offending either the partner concerned or the internal norms gets to be a challenge that has to be fought on a daily basis.

title: Human Resources Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Tiered Approach**
 In Line With The Commitment To Safeguard Capacity And Support Personnel Already In The Organization, a Majority Of UNDP UNCDF/UNV Vacancies Are Advertised Using a Tiered Application Process Whereby
   

  

* Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates


 Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.
   

  

**Background**
 UNDP has been working in India since 1951 in almost all areas of human development. Together with the Government of India and development partners, we have worked towards eradicating poverty, reducing inequalities, strengthening local governance, enhancing community resilience, protecting the environment, supporting policy initiatives and institutional reforms, and accelerating sustainable development for all.
   

  

 With projects and programmes in every state and union territory in India, UNDP works with national and subnational government, and diverse development actors to deliver people\-centric results, particularly for the most vulnerable and marginalized communities. As the integrator for collective action on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) within the UN system, we are committed to supporting the Government of India’s national development vision and priorities and accelerating the achievement of the SDGs for the people and the planet.
   

  

 UNDP India’s New Country Programme (2023\-2027\) Builds On Our Prior Work And Aims To Provide An Integrated Approach To Development Solutions In Three Strategic Portfolios
   

  

* Strong, accountable and evidence\-led institutions for accelerated achievement of the SDGs.
* Enhanced economic opportunities and social protection to reduce inequality, with a focus on the marginalized.
* Climate\-smart solutions, sustainable ecosystems and resilient development for reduced vulnerability.


 South\-South cooperation, gender equality and social inclusion are promoted across the pillars. The programme is supported by a framework of renewed partnerships and blended finance solutions, strategic innovation and accelerator labs, and data and digital architecture.
   

  

**Office/Unit/Project Description**
 The Human Resources (HR) unit provides support to Country Office (CO) management in ensuring that the office is appropriately staffed with high quality and engaged personnel who receive the guidance, feedback, and development they need to fully contribute to the CO’s agenda and Sustainable Development Goals. The HR team applies strategic human resource management policies, procedures, programs, and solutions – that leverage both technology and analytics – to promote a strong people management culture and high performing, diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace.
   

  

**Main Purpose**
 The HR Analyst, under the overall guidance and supervision of Head of HR, supports the effective delivery of HR services in the Country Office by applying HR policies, implementing procedures, and providing solutions that promote a collaborative, client\-focused environment.
   

  

 The HR Analyst supports Head of HR in providing day to day support to the concerned HR team members in managing recruitment, onboarding and other HR services and works in close collaboration with the Programme, Operations, and project teams in the CO, UNDP HQ OHR Business Partners, and staff in GSSC and other UN Agencies to ensure successful CO performance in HR management. He/she will also lead in coordination Learning and Talent Development initiatives, delivery of learning, capacity\-building, that enhance employee capability, strengthen organizational performance, and promote a culture of continuous learning. The role support in designing learning and training programmes, talent management processes, and development interventions ensuring they are well\-designed, effectively implemented, and aligned with organizational goals.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
**Support in implementation of HR strategies and policies.**
* Ensure full compliance of HR activities with UN rules and regulations and UNDP policies, procedures, and strategies; support in effective implementation of the internal controls; and analysis of supporting parameters, proper design and functioning of the HR management system and practices.
* Provide input and support to CO HR business processes mapping and update of internal HR Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) where needed in CO to supplement SOPs issued by GSSC/OHR.
* Support in implementing a strategic approach to CO HR interventions including recruitment, proper use of contractual modalities, workforce planning, position management, job classification, performance management, personnel needs and wellbeing, and career development.
* Support the Supervisor and CO Management for audit and compliance.


**Ensure effective human resources management of recruitment and onboarding**
* Overseeing and provide day to day guidance on Project and Programme recruitments and onboarding for NPSA and interns and ensure managing transparent and competitive recruitment and selection processes in coordination with GSSC and locally with hiring managers that includes updating job descriptions, preparing vacancy announcements, screening candidates, organizing and participating in the interview panels, recommending recruitment strategies, and submission of compliance review cases as per the actions delegated to CO. Facilitate recruitment for projects and at the request of UN partner agencies.
* Liaise and coordinate with relevant CO Recruitment focal point and GSSC teams on monitoring and tracking of all transactions related to positions, recruitment, HR data, and provide oversight of clustered services and report to supervisor and/or senior CO management for any cases to be escalated.
* Support in managing the recruitment for Country Office, FTA and international positions in consultation with GSSC as delegated.
* Upon delegation of responsibility, perform HR Manager functions in ERP and validate cost\-recovery charges in ERP for HR services provided by UNDP to other Agencies.
* Ensure that Roster Database is regularly updated and documents are available for immediate reference.
* Ensuring that all planned positions are accurately captured and updated in the project organogram. This includes coordinating with relevant teams to confirm role titles, reporting lines, and staffing status; validating that new, revised, or phased\-out positions are reflected appropriately; and ensuring the organogram remains an up\-to\-date and reliable reference for project staffing and planning.
* When delegated support in managing the end\-to\-end process for lateral transfers including ensuring proper documentation and approvals, facilitating communication between hiring and releasing units, tracking progress of the transfer workflow, and ensuring that position records, contracts, database and systems.


**Ensure proper staff/ non staff performance management, learning and talent management, and career development in the CO.**
* Under the guidance of Head of HR, take lead to develop and implement the UNDP India Country Office Learning and Talent Development Plan in close coordination with People for 2030 Champion Group, Talent Development Unit and develop whole\-office learning plan and learning calendar aligned with business needs, and reporting on learning activities and budget utilization.
* Support the design and implementation of strategies on staff wellbeing related issues, including analysis and recommendations of Engagement Surveys results. Support the co\-creation of a local engagement survey action plan.
* Promote peer learning, coaching, mentoring, and knowledge\-sharing; engage staff as trainers and participants; coordinate the Learning/Development Committee; and ensure effective implementation of the Training Policy and People 2030 initiatives.
* Provide guidance on the PMD policy, cycle and process, support supervisors in developing and implementing Performance Improvement Plans, conduct regular training sessions for supervisors and employees.
* Identify and coordinate external trainers, support facilitators, design and deliver training materials and sessions, and plan high\-quality training activities through a structured learning calendar.
* Encourage on\-the\-job learning, virtual and cross\-team assignments, professional certification programmes, inter\-agency development activities, and innovative learning solutions in close coordination with Supervisor, People for 2030 Champion Group and global Talent Development Units.
* Manage the organization, administration, and logistics of learning activities—including materials, equipment, scheduling, and partner approvals—to ensure smooth delivery and staff participation.
* Disseminate corporate talent development opportunities, engage with the TDM network, track and report mandatory learning compliance through PowerBI dashboards, provide monthly updates to management, and follow up with staff and teams to ensure timely completion.
* Track and compile the PMDs and share regular updates on the completion and follow up with the staff and supervisor to ensure timely completion.
* Organize regular orientation, learning, Ethics and Code of Conduct sessions, provide guidance on UNDP complaint mechanisms, disseminate related information, and support the Head of HR in handling cases when required.
* As delegated, when required in line with policy, support the Supervisor in developing a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP). This includes assisting in identifying performance gaps, drafting clear and measurable objectives, outlining expected competencies and timelines, and detailing the support mechanisms to be provided.
* As delegated, facilitate the opening of Detail Assignment opportunities with approval from Senior Management and Head HR ensuring that the opportunities are widely circulated. Manage the selection process for Detail Assignments by coordinating with Hiring Team, screening applications against required competencies, organizing interviews and assessments, supporting panel documentation and ensuring that Letters of Assignment (LOA) are issued accurately and on time. Maintain a comprehensive tracker of all active and completed Detail Assignments.


**Supporting CO knowledge building and knowledge sharing focusing on achievement of the following results:**
* Maintain and update knowledge repositories, CO databases, and digital platforms, ensuring accessibility and usability for internal and external stakeholders.
* Promote the use of innovative digital tools, AI\-driven knowledge systems, and collaborative platforms to enhance knowledge exchange and management.
* Compile and disseminate information extracted from all available information management systems as delegated;
* Consolidate evaluation findings, lessons learned and recommendations to be disseminated in learning events and channeled into decision\-making processes.


 The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.
   

  

 Institutional Arrangement
   

  

**Reporting To: Head of HR**
**Reposes to this position (if applicable): N/A**
**Competencies**
***Core***
**Achieve Results:** 
 LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline
   

  

**Think Innovatively:** 
 LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements
   

  

**Learn Continuously:** 
 LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback
   

  

**Adapt with Agility:** 
 LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible
   

  

**Act with Determination:** 
 LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident
   

  

**Engage and Partner:** 
 LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships
   

  

**Enable Diversity and Inclusion:** 
 LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination
   

  

**Cross\-Functional \& Technical competencies (insert up to 7 competencies)**
**Thematic Area** 
**Name** 
**Definition**
 HR – Learning and Development L\&D Planning Ability to identify organizational learning priorities aligned with the business strategy using key stakeholder involvement to ensure appropriate learning and optimal return\-on\-investment
   

  

 HR \- Recruitment Recruitment Design and Management Knowledge of, ability to design and manage end\-to\-end recruitment processes
   

  

 HR – Recruitment
   

  

 Assessment and Selection
   

  

 Knowledge and ability to apply various candidate assessment and selection methodologies, tools and platforms; ability to effectively align them with specific recruitment needs
   

  

 Business Management Digital Awareness and Literacy Ability to monitor new and emerging technologies, as well as understand their usage, potential, limitations, impact, and added value. Ability to rapidly and readily adopt and use new technologies in professional activities, and to empower others to use them as needed. Knowledge of the usage of digital technologies and emerging trends
   

  

 Business Management Working with Evidence and Data Ability to inspect, cleanse, transform and model data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions and supporting decision\-making
   

  

 Business Management
   

  

 Customer Satisfaction/Client Management
   

  

 Ability to respond timely and appropriately with a sense of urgency, provide consistent solutions, and deliver timely and quality results and/or solutions to fulfil and understand the real customers' needs. Provide inputs to the development of customer service strategy. Look for ways to add value beyond clients' immediate requests. Ability to anticipate client's upcoming needs and concerns.
   

  

 Business Development Knowledge Facilitation
   

  

 Ability to animate individuals and groups, internally and externally, and to design and facilitate activities, to share and exchange knowledge, information and ideas. Knowledge of tools and approaches to stimulate active participation, contribution, and exchange.
   

  

**Education**
**Required Skills and Experience**
* Advanced university degree (master's degree or equivalent) in Human Resources, Business Administration or any other related field is required. Or
* A first\-level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the areas stated above, in combination with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.


**Experience**
* Applicants with master’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field of study are not required to have professional work experience.
* Applicants with a bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) are required to have a minimum of two (2\) years of relevant professional experience at the national or international level in providing HR advisory services and/or managing staff and operational systems.


**Desired skills in addition to the competencies covered in the Competencies section**
* Experience in the use of computers and office software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.) and advanced knowledge of web\-based management systems such as ERP.
* Experience in HR Services/HR Management: HR policy implementation, compliance, Learning and Development, recruitment and onboarding of staff, maintenance of HR documentation, provision of HR advisory services, Performance Management, experience in managing separation processes.
* Proven experience in leading and coordinating Learning and Talent Development initiatives, including learning needs assessment, development of office\-wide learning plans aligned with PMDs and business priorities, with hands\-on oversight of learning delivery, external trainers, logistics, and mandatory learning compliance.
* Demonstrated experience with digital, blended, and innovative learning solutions, learning analytics and dashboards, and promoting peer learning, coaching, mentoring, and on\-the\-job development initiatives.
* Proven experience in managing and overseeing end\-to\-end recruitment and onboarding services, ensuring transparent and competitive selection processes, effective coordination with hiring managers and shared service centers, compliance with organizational policies, and timely onboarding across multiple contractual modalities.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, and risk management in HR operations.
* Experience in strong communication skills both written and verbal to communicate and coordinate effectively with programme units, staff, and HR counterparts.
* Experience of working with UN, international or national organization.
* Prior experience in a direct or indirect supervisory role


**Required Language** 
 : Fluency in English and Hindi is required.
   

  

**Equal opportunity**
 As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.
   

  

 UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.
   

  

**Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority**
 UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.
   

  

**Right to select multiple candidates**
 UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

title: AI Business Analyst
description:
As an AI Business Analyst, you will help improve the reasoning, analytical, and decision\-making capabilities of next\-generation AI systems. You will leverage your business analysis expertise to evaluate, create, review, and refine high\-quality business scenarios, requirements, and analytical datasets that enable AI models to better understand business processes, stakeholder needs, and real\-world problem\-solving.
 



 Your responsibilities may include reviewing AI\-generated business analyses, evaluating requirement documents, creating user stories, analyzing business workflows, validating process models, ranking AI\-generated outputs, and ensuring business accuracy while maintaining industry best practices. You'll collaborate with AI researchers and data teams to help train and fine\-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) for business analysis, consulting, and enterprise use cases.
 



 Responsibilities
 



 Evaluate and review AI\-generated business analysis documents for accuracy, completeness, and clarity.
 



 Analyze and annotate business cases, workflows, process diagrams, and requirement documentation.
 



 Create, rewrite, and improve business scenarios, user stories, BRDs, FRDs, and acceptance criteria.
 



 Compare multiple AI\-generated business solutions and rank them based on relevance, feasibility, and business value.
 



 Identify gaps, inconsistencies, ambiguities, and logical errors in AI\-generated requirements.
 



 Validate business process documentation, stakeholder requirements, and functional specifications.
 



 Ensure AI\-generated content follows industry\-standard Business Analysis practices and terminology.
 



 Perform quality assurance on business datasets, annotations, and AI\-generated outputs.
 



 Follow detailed annotation guidelines while maintaining high\-quality standards.
 



 Contribute domain expertise to improve AI models' understanding of business analysis concepts and enterprise workflows.
 



 Requirements
 



 Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Economics, Management, or a related field.
 



 Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
 



 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 



 Good understanding of business processes, requirement gathering, and documentation.
 



 Ability to evaluate information objectively and follow detailed annotation guidelines.
 



 Basic computer and internet proficiency.
 



 Prior experience in Business Analysis, Product Management, Consulting, Process Improvement, QA, Documentation, or related fields is preferred but not mandatory.
 



 Preferred Qualifications
 



 Experience working as a Business Analyst or Product Analyst.
 



 Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, SDLC, and software development processes.
 



 Knowledge of SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or business reporting tools.
 



 Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar collaboration platforms.
 



 Familiarity with Business Process Modeling (BPMN), UML, process mapping, or workflow documentation.
 



 Experience with AI, Generative AI, NLP, or Large Language Models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI tools.
 



 Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high\-quality work.
 



 Skills
 



 Business Analysis
 



 Requirements Gathering
 



 Business Process Analysis
 



 User Story Creation
 



 Functional Documentation
 



 Process Mapping
 



 Data Analysis
 



 AI Data Annotation
 



 Prompt Evaluation
 



 Content Review
 



 Quality Assurance
 



 SQL (Basic)
 



 Agile \& Scrum
 



 Critical Thinking
 



 Communication Skills
 



 What You'll Gain
 



 Work on cutting\-edge Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) projects.
 



 Flexible remote work opportunities.
 



 Gain hands\-on experience in AI model training, evaluation, and business domain annotation.
 



 Develop expertise in AI, business analysis, enterprise workflows, and language technologies.
 



 Collaborate with global AI researchers, engineers, and data teams to build next\-generation AI systems.

title: Future Talent - Junior Analyst
description:
*At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.*
*And we need people like you to make it happen.*
***We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.***
**About Future Talent Program**
 Future Talent Program is a Trainee Program within Tetra Pak. We offer a permanent position from start in July 2026\. You will onboard an individual designed development program for 24 months connected to a specific position and the Tetra Pak organization. During the program you will participate in trainings and job rotations throughout various parts of Tetra Pak to explore your potential and grow as a person.
   

  

 As a Trainee here with us, you will get to know our entire business and collaborate with colleagues all over the world. And this is just the beginning of your Tetra Pak career!
   

  

 From day one you will be delivering results as a true team member following a development plan that is specifically designed for you and your position. The plan includes a combination of project\-rotations, international assignments, work within your own department as well as formal training and mentorship from a network of colleagues all over the world. The program will give you broad insight into our company, our culture and our values. After completing this program, you will have gained knowledge, built relationships, and had experiences to help you continue your exciting career within our company.
   

  

**Future Talent Program\-OTM**
 We are looking for a talented recent graduated who has creative and innovative thinking, problem\-solving skills with personal initiative, who demonstrates a passion for applying theoretical learning to face challenges. Current, with strong communication skills and who are committed to being true team players.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to be part of the OTM ( Oracle Transportation Management) that will enable Tetra Pak to be successful now and in the future. The mission of the OTM team is to enable governed, trustable, and quality Service. It is a cross functional and diverse team that interfaces with all business units of the enterprise. You will get the opportunity to become an expert in a growing work area and on market leading solutions.
   

  

 To be successful in this role you need to be a team player and have the ability to build trust on all levels. Furthermore, you have a strong drive, are result oriented and have an interest for both business and tech. You have easy to see the big picture but also have attention to details and care about quality.
   

  

 You are comfortable with communication, explaining new concepts and helping others to understand. You should be able to work independently and be eager to find new and creative solutions to challenges.
   

  

 The program starts on 1st July 2026\.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Tetra Pak Global Information Management (Global IM) supports the Tetra Pak Group with all aspects of Information Management. We set the information management strategy and standards and work together with Tetra Pak’s Global Process Owners to automate our business processes making sure we run projects \& services that provide the greatest value for Tetra Pak and its customers. Global IM has approx. 900 employees in four main sites: Chakan in India, Lund in Sweden, Denton in the USA and in Singapore.
   

  

 Tetra Pak Global Information Management is currently seeking an analyst who can demonstrate strong understanding and hands on experience on logistics and transportation industry to join the “business\-IT” in
 **Order Fulfillment Packaging Material** 
 related Projects and Service Delivery Team (SDT). Team members work as a pool of resources with assignments to
 **Oracle Transport Management** 
 related projects, GAPs (small developments) and service support activities as driven by demands from the business.
   

  

 This is a permanent position, based in Chakan, India.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As Tetra Pak’s new IT Analyst resource you will be working on various business applications to support Tetra Pak´s core business units. These business applications will be based on the
 **Oracle technology** 
 on
 **Oracle Transport Management System** 
 . The OTM team members are mostly located in Chakan and in Singapore. Hence meetings and phone calls can occur outside normal business hours.
   

  

* You will work with information flow of a specific Business Process end to end, being able to identify any impact of business processes and IT Services in relation to new business requirements and IT solutions.
* You will work to support project team members and work with continuous improvement gaps, project pre\-study preparations and design ideas.
* You will be expected to lead various small work team e.g. gap lead, application specialist (application lead), test lead, etc. As needed, we wish for you to be a backup / assistant Subject Matter Expert (SME) and to assist the Solution Architect and or Service Architect. In this assistant SME role, you will co\-lead/lead discussions with the business and or technical team members and provided needed solutioning and guidance.


**We believe you have**
* You have a university degree or a diploma from a business or engineering course of study.
* You have 1 \- 2 years’ work experience in Logistic and Transport management areas and a very good understanding of the complete end\-to\-end supply chain.
* You have a personal drive, you are curious, would like to learn new things and drive the future.
* You are result\-oriented.
* You are strong analytical.
* You have good communication skills.
* You enjoy working in a team.
* You have a very good command of English Language
* Functional and Technical knowledge of relevant Transport systems is a plus.
* Some Experience some Transport Mgt. system or ERP implementation and business analysis and support is a plus.
* Good to have experience or training on:


* 
+ Any ERP solutions
+ MS SQL Dbase
+ Excel
+ Other MS office tools


**We Offer You**
* A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
* A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
* An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
* Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements


**Apply Now**
 If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/.
   

  

 This job posting expires on
 **27\-04\-2026\.**
 If you have any questions about your application, please contact
 **Tanvi Maheshwari** 
 .

We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.*

title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)
* Familiarity with project management or change management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, Prosci, Kotter)
* Familiarity with technology concepts such as workflow automation, system integration, APIs, and cloud\-based platforms
* Business analysis certification (e.g., BCS, IIBA/CBAP) or Agile/Scrum certification (CSM, CSPO) a plus
* Undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a leading institution, ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a field with role\-relevant transferable skills


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**

* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

 Your responsibilities may include reviewing AI\-generated machine learning solutions, evaluating model architectures, analyzing datasets, writing technical prompts, creating reference implementations, comparing AI\-generated responses, and ensuring technical accuracy, mathematical correctness, and industry best practices. You'll collaborate with AI researchers and data teams to help train and fine\-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) for machine learning, data science, and artificial intelligence tasks.
