 and products delivered in
 **more than 100 jurisdictions worldwide** 
 , we operate at scale while staying closely connected to costumers we serve. If you’re ready to bring your talent to a team shaping the future of entertainment, your next big move starts here \-
 **www.igt.com** 
 .
   

  

**Overview**
 IGT is seeking an HRIS Analyst to support HR systems through configuration, data management, system support, and process execution activities. This role is responsible for performing system updates, supporting end users, maintaining data accuracy, and assisting with HRIS enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

 The HRIS Analyst works collaboratively with HRIS team members, IT, and business stakeholders to support day\-to\-day HR system operations while developing expertise in HR technology platforms and processes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support day\-to\-day administration and maintenance of SAP SuccessFactors and related HR technology solutions.
* Process employee data changes and system transactions with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Perform system audits, data validation, and quality assurance activities to ensure data integrity and compliance.
* Support SuccessFactors reporting activities, including Story Reporting, standard reports, and data validation efforts.
* Respond to user inquiries and troubleshoot HR system issues, escalating complex issues as needed.
* Assist with testing activities for system enhancements, releases, integrations, and upgrades, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Support system integrations, security administration, role\-based permissions, and workflow troubleshooting.
* Maintain system documentation, standard operating procedures, job aids, and knowledge base content.
* Partner with HRIS team members, IT, and business stakeholders to support system enhancements, process improvements, and operational projects.
* Identify opportunities to improve HR processes through automation, self\-service capabilities, and system optimization.


**Qualifications**
* 2–5 years of HRIS experience with hands\-on experience supporting SAP SuccessFactors.
* Working knowledge of SuccessFactors Employee Central and familiarity with additional modules such as Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance \& Goals, Compensation, Learning, or Succession preferred.
* Experience supporting system configuration, workflows, business rules, permissions, reporting, and data management activities.
* Experience performing testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for HR systems.
* Strong understanding of data quality, validation, and audit processes.
* Experience working with HR system reporting tools and Microsoft Excel for data analysis and reconciliation.
* Ability to analyze system issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions.
* Strong communication, customer service, and collaboration skills.
* Experience working with Information Technology teams and business stakeholders preferred.


****Key Competencies****
* SAP SuccessFactors knowledge and system administration
* Data quality and attention to detail
* System troubleshooting and problem\-solving
* Process improvement and continuous learning
* Customer service and stakeholder support
* Collaboration and teamwork
* Operational excellence and execution


 IGT is committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace that reflects the global communities and customers we serve. We strive to create an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered.
   

  

 IGT is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This commitment applies to all employment practices, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, and termination.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Rhombus Power, Inc. delivers AI\-powered predictive intelligence in real time for defense and national security organizations worldwide. Our mission\-built products— Ambient AI and Guardian— are transforming strategic, operational, and tactical decision\-making. By empowering the shift from reactive analysis to proactive, predictive intelligence and decision support, Rhombus Power is providing foresight and freedom of action when it matters most.
   

  

 Come join our cross\-disciplinary and world\-class team that is delivering game\-changing solutions to transform global security.
   

  

 Learn more about Rhombus Power, Inc. and watch a demonstration of Guardian, our AI Platform here:
   

  

 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=3PxY6su1Q\-Q
   

  

 https://www.youtube.com/@rhombuspower8558/videos
   

  

 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=Iby5WVNfQiI
   

  

 See the following articles to learn more about what we do:
   

  

 https://www.rhombuspower.com/news\-and\-media
   

  

 Rhombus Power India is purposefully transforming the nation’s defense and national security enterprises with Guardian, its Artificial Intelligence platform for strategic, operational, and tactical decision\-making at the speed of relevance.
   

  

 We are looking for people who are driven by a sense of purpose. In this role, you will serve as a
 **Data Engineer** 
 to solve our customer’s uniquely complex problems. We expect you to be a systems\-level thinker and a real doer. You will excel in this role if you are hungry to make a difference and are intellectually bold. And we sure hope that you smile when you hear our clients say, “If we can dream it, Rhombus can do it.”
   

  

 Come join our cross\-disciplinary and world\-class team of technologists who are working hard every day to deliver game\-changing solutions to transform national security.
   

  

**Location**
 New Delhi, India
   

  

**Job Description**
 Rhombus’
 **Data Engineers** 
 are instrumental in designing and implementing data engineering activities on topical, mission\-driven projects that inform our national security agenda. They analyze, build, and maintain our organization’s data infrastructure and processing systems. As a
 **Data Engineer,** 
 you’ll perform various code development and query needs for integration with new and existing applications, dashboards and machine learning pipelines. You’ll work cross functionally with other departments and utilize your skills at all stages of the analytics pipeline to create results that drive business values and customer success! You’ll be asked to travel to client sites where you’ll engage and collaborate directly with the client to discuss data pipelines, solutioning, and to ensure a strong client connection.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop code using various programming and scripting languages to automate data ingestion and improve data management processes.
* Architect data repositories, stand up data platforms and develop data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and aggregation.
* Review existing architecture, data strategy, and improve processes for data governance, data quality, and metadata management.
* Extract and analyze raw data from multiple data sources via APIs, SQL Stored Procedures, or Python scripts.
* Ability to develop scripts and programs for converting various types of data into usable formats and support project team to scale, monitor and operate data platforms.
* Collaborate with a multi\-disciplinary team of analysts, data scientists, data engineers, developers, and data consumers in a fast\-paced, agile environment.
* You’ll use your experience in analytical exploration and data examination while you manage the assessment, design, building, and maintenance of scalable platforms for clients.
* Communicate project status and results to various levels of leadership.


**Qualifications**
* A Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems/Sciences, or other relevant area (or equivalent experience) and at least 1 year of professional experience, or a Master’s degree with strong academic project experience.
* Experience with 1 or more programming and scripting languages, with a strong focus on Python, Pandas and Numpy. Other languages include: Shell, PERL, Java, C/C\+\+/C\#, Scala, etc.
* Experience with 1 or more of the following relational, noSQL and/or file based storage (e.g. MYSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres, Hbase, DynamoDB, etc.)
* Experience building and maintaining ETL data pipelines
* Experience with software development life cycle including testing, documenting, delivery and support
* Working knowledge of AWS/cloud technologies
* Experience using query optimization as well as data modeling techniques.
* Familiarity with machine learning frameworks (such as TensorFlow, Scikit\-Learn, etc.)


**Personal Qualities**
* Ability to contextualize data as it relates to Rhombus’ vision. We want someone who can understand the “why” and “so what”, and not just the “how”. Our Data Engineers help us transmit the enthusiasm we have around the data work to the individuals doing that work.
* Must have strong problem\-solving skills and demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills.
* We’re seeking folks with strong intellectual curiosity and creativity, with an ability and willingness to learn new skills and apply novel solutions to problems.
* Comfort in a fast\-paced start\-up environment is crucial, with the ability to consistently revise your approach in response to new information, and to be flexible and adaptive.

title: Data Engineer , WWGS GRIT
description:
**Description**
 Are you excited about building data infrastructure that powers one of the world's largest grocery businesses? We're looking for a Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines that drive critical business decisions across Amazon's grocery portfolio — including Amazon Fresh, Whole Foods Market, and more.
   

  

 In this role, you'll build and optimize data workflows, develop data models, and create robust infrastructure that supports analytics across areas like product selection, pricing, promotions, marketing, and how customers discover groceries online. You'll collaborate with analysts, scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high\-quality, reliable data solutions that enable smarter decisions at a global scale.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to work on complex, high\-impact data challenges in a fast\-paced environment where your contributions directly influence how millions of customers shop for groceries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and load data from multiple sources into Amazon's data warehouse and data lake environments.
   

  

 Build and optimize data models that support reporting, analytics, and machine learning use cases across WWGS domains.
   

  

 Write efficient and well\-structured SQL queries and scripts to process large\-scale datasets.
   

  

 Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data pipeline failures to ensure data availability and reliability within defined SLAs.
   

  

 Collaborate with Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver fit\-for\-purpose data solutions.
   

  

 Implement data quality checks, validations, and alerting mechanisms to ensure accuracy and completeness of data.
   

  

 Develop and maintain technical documentation for data pipelines, data models, and system architecture.
   

  

 Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices within the team.
   

  

 Support the automation of manual data processes to improve operational efficiency.
   

  

 Work with big data technologies (Spark, Hive, EMR) and AWS services to build performant data infrastructure at scale
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Your primary focus is making sure clean, reliable data flows to the people who need it — every single day. You'll start your morning checking pipeline health, fixing any issues that popped up overnight, and ensuring teams have the data they need to make decisions.
   

  

 From there, you might spend time building a new data pipeline to support a product launch, optimizing a slow\-running query, or working with an analyst to figure out the best way to model a tricky dataset. No two days look exactly the same, but the common thread is solving data problems that directly impact how customers shop for groceries.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with analysts, scientists, and business teams across areas like product selection, pricing, promotions, and customer growth. Sometimes you'll go beyond your regular responsibilities — jumping into an urgent data investigation, prototyping a new automation, or helping a teammate debug a complex issue.
   

  

 The pace is fast, the problems are real, and the work you do shows up in how millions of customers experience grocery shopping on Amazon.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We're a team of analysts, data engineers, and software developer who are passionate about one thing: making grocery shopping better for customers around the world. Our mission is to build the data foundation that helps Amazon's grocery business — including Amazon Fresh and Whole Foods Market — make faster, smarter decisions across different products and how customers find what they need.
   

  

 We work in a collaborative, curiosity\-driven environment where everyone's ideas matter. You'll sit alongside people who love solving puzzles with data, and you'll partner with product teams, business leaders, and engineers across the grocery organization. We believe great data infrastructure is invisible to the end user but transformative for the business — and we take pride in building systems that are reliable, scalable, and easy to understand.
   

  

 Our culture values ownership, learning, and transparency. We celebrate wins together, share knowledge openly, and support each other through challenges. Whether you're building your first production pipeline or mentoring a teammate through a tricky problem, you'll find a team that invests in your growth and trusts you to make an impact from day one.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of data engineering experience
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
* Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
* Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc.


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company**

 core team now.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and motivated Junior Automation Tester with 1\+ years of
 



 professional experience to join our Quality Assurance team. In this role, you will play a crucial
 



 part in ensuring the reliability, performance, and functionality of our web applications.
 



 You will be responsible for building and maintaining automated test suites, identifying software
 



 defects, and working closely with the development team to deliver high\-quality software. The
 



 ideal candidate has strong hands\-on experience with the Selenium framework and a solid
 



 understanding of both frontend and backend testing methodologies.

 Selenium

 .
* Testing Methodologies: Comprehensive understanding of the software testing life cycle (STLC), including UI testing, backend testing, and stress testing.



  





***Technical Skills***



* Programming Languages: Proficiency in at least one language commonly used with Selenium (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, or C\#).
* API Tools: Experience using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or SoapUI for backend and RESTful API testing.

* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and integrating automated tests into the deployment process.
* Experience with behavior\-driven development (BDD) frameworks like Cucumber.

* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.

**Job Description**
**Job Title**

 IT — Command Centre (DevOps)

 Full\-time, Permanent

 24×7 rotational shifts
   

  

**About Insightsoftware**
 insightsoftware is a global provider of connected solutions for the Office of the CFO. We empower business leaders with accessible insights and connected solutions to drive actionable business strategy. With operations spanning 40\+ countries, we help finance and IT teams work smarter, faster, and with greater confidence.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are establishing a new Command Centre in Hyderabad to provide around\-the\-clock monitoring, incident response, and operational support for our global multi\-cloud infrastructure, including AWS, Azure, and on\-premises environments. The Command Centre Specialist will serve as an active operator, responsible for system monitoring, incident triage and resolution, execution of runbooks, and escalation of issues in accordance with established procedures. This role is highly execution\-oriented and supports DevOps teams worldwide, adhering to ITIL best practices. The initial three to six months require on\-site presence in Hyderabad for environment familiarization and team integration, after which the position will transition to remote work.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Incident Response and Troubleshooting
   

  

* Monitor alerts and triage incoming incidents—classify, prioritize, and document in Jira Service Management per ITIL guidelines.
* Troubleshoot issues across multi cloud infrastructure (EC2, VPC, VPN, load balancers), identity and access management (IAM, SSO, directory services), networking (DNS, firewalls, routing), databases, and application layers.
* Execute established runbooks and standard operating procedures to resolve or contain incidents within SLA targets.
* Escalate unresolved or high\-severity incidents to senior specialists or engineering teams with clear, accurate context.


 Monitoring and Alerting
   

  

* Monitor multi\-cloud infrastructure, network, and security tooling 24×7 using enterprise observability platforms.
* Identify anomalies, threshold breaches, and potential security events; take first\-response action or escalate per SOPs.
* Flag false positives and noisy alerts to senior specialists for threshold tuning and runbook updates.


 Shift Operations
   

  

* Participate in 24×7 rotational shifts; execute clean handoffs with detailed shift logs.
* Follow escalation matrices and communication protocols during all incidents.
* Maintain accurate, real\-time operational logs throughout each shift.


 Documentation and Knowledge Contribution
   

  

* Update and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and SOPs in Confluence as issues are resolved.
* Document recurring incidents and known workarounds to build the Command Centre knowledge base.
* Log all actions taken during incidents for post\-incident reviews and audit trails.


 SLA Tracking and Reporting
   

  

* Track incident response and resolution times against defined SLAs; flag breaches or at\-risk tickets promptly.
* Contribute to operational dashboards and shift reports as directed by senior specialists.


**Required Qualifications**
* 3–5 years in a Command Centre, NOC, or equivalent 24×7 operations environment.
* 1–2 years of hands\-on exposure to AWS and/or Azure—working familiarity with EC2, VPC, VPN, and IAM basics.
* Practical troubleshooting skills across cloud, identity, network, database, and application layers.
* Awareness of Kubernetes and containerized workloads sufficient to interpret alerts.
* Networking fundamentals—TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and basic routing.
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts (Incident, Problem, Change Management).
* Experience with at least one monitoring/alerting tool—PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, or Azure Monitor.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for shift logs, incident documentation, and escalations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification; any AWS or Azure foundational/associate certification.
* Experience with Jira Service Management and Confluence.
* Basic scripting skills (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for log analysis or simple automation.
* Prior experience in a global, multi\-time\-zone support environment.


 What We Offer
   

  

* Be part of a greenfield Command Centre build in a high\-growth global software company.
* Hands\-on exposure to a modern multi\-cloud tech stack (AWS, Azure, SaaS, enterprise platforms).
* Clear growth path—learn from senior specialists and grow into advanced operational roles.
* Collaborative, results\-oriented culture underpinned by our core values of Winning Attitude, One Team, and Disciplined Execution.
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional development opportunities.


****Additional Information****
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

 insightsoftware About Us: Hear From Our Team
   

  

 Background checks are required for employment with insightsoftware, where permitted by country, state/province.

title: RAG AI Developer (LLM + Retrieval) – EdTech
description:
**Job Summary:** 





 We are looking for a
 
**RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) AI Developer** 

 to build and improve AI features for our EdTech products—such as course Q\&A bots, tutor assistants, content search, and internal knowledge assistants. You will work on document ingestion, embeddings, retrieval pipelines, evaluation, and deployment.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Build and maintain
 
**RAG pipelines** 

 : ingestion → chunking → embedding → vector storage → retrieval → generation.
* Implement hybrid search (semantic \+ keyword), reranking, filters, and metadata\-based retrieval.
* Integrate LLMs with tools/frameworks (e.g.,
 
**LangChain / LlamaIndex** 

 or custom pipelines).
* Work with
 
**vector databases** 

 (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, Milvus) and optimize retrieval performance.
* Create evaluation metrics for RAG quality (faithfulness, relevance, context precision/recall) and reduce hallucinations.
* Build prompt templates, guardrails, and citation\-based answers.
* Deploy services/APIs (FastAPI/Flask), monitor latency/cost, and implement caching strategies.
* Collaborate with product/content teams to define data sources and user workflows.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 



* **1\+ year experience** 

 building NLP/LLM features (must have some hands\-on RAG or retrieval work).
* Strong Python skills.
* Experience with embeddings, chunking strategies, and document loaders (PDF/HTML/Doc).
* Familiarity with at least one vector DB and retrieval methods (cosine similarity, MMR, etc.).
* Understanding of basic ML concepts and text preprocessing.



  





**Preferred (Nice to Have):** 



* Experience with
 
**OpenAI / Anthropic / Google / open\-source LLMs** 

 (Llama, Mistral, etc.).
* Experience with OCR pipelines (for scanned PDFs), speech/text, or multilingual content (helpful for EdTech).
* Experience with Docker, cloud deployment (AWS/GCP/Azure), CI/CD.
* Prior work on chatbots, tutoring systems, or knowledge bases.



  





**What Success Looks Like (KPIs):** 



* Higher answer accuracy \+ lower hallucination rate
* Faster retrieval latency and lower compute cost
* Clear citations and better user satisfaction on Q\&A flows

 On\-site – Girgaon , Mumbai

description:
I am delighted to share that we are inviting applications for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under our ANRF\-sponsored research project:
 



  





 "साक्ष्य — Evidence Retrieval and Construction for Fact\-Verification to Mitigate Misinformation in Indic Language Context"
 



  





 The position is based at the Department of CSE, SVNIT Surat. The selected candidate will have the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge research in Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing, with the possibility of pursuing a Ph.D. at Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology (SVNIT), Surat (subject to Institute eligibility criteria).
 



  





 📅 Application Deadline: 30 July 2026 (5:00 PM)
 



 📝 How to Apply: Please refer to the attached advertisement for complete details or click the link: https://lnkd.in/d3zTgNMz
 



 📧 Queries: shrikant@coed.svnit.ac.in
 



  





 🌏 About the Project
 



  





 Our project, साक्ष्य, aims to develop an AI\-powered multilingual fact\-verification framework capable of automatically retrieving reliable evidence, reasoning over multiple information sources, and generating transparent explanations for claims in Indian languages. The project will combine advances in Information Retrieval, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Question Answering, and Multilingual AI to build trustworthy fact\-verification systems for Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, and other Indic languages.
 



  





 Beyond combating misinformation, the technologies developed in this project have broad applications in journalism, digital governance, education, media analytics, public policy, and trustworthy AI, helping build a more reliable and inclusive digital information ecosystem.
 



  





 🔬 We are looking for candidates interested in:
 



 ✅ NLP \& Large Language Models (LLMs)
 



 ✅ Information Retrieval \& RAG
 



 ✅ Working on Indian languages, e.g. Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi
 



 ✅ Misinformation Mitigation \& Explainable AI
 



 ✅ Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face
 



  





 If you are passionate about AI research and want to contribute to technologies with meaningful societal impact, I encourage you to apply. Please also share this opportunity with students and researchers who may be interested.
 



  





 My sincere thanks to Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) for supporting this vision, and to all my collaborators, mentors, colleagues, and students whose encouragement and contributions made this possible.
 



  





 Looking forward to an exciting research journey ahead!

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
THE HUSTLE HOUSE · NOW HIRING
 



 Full Stack Developer
 



  





 Live products. Real ownership from day one.
 



 Production software for real clients — not tickets, not mockups.
 



 One seat. Apply if you've shipped things that work.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 AT A GLANCE
 



 • Department: Development
 



 • Reports To: Full\-Stack Lead — direct line to founders
 



 • Seats Open: 1 — one candidate, no exceptions
 



 • Employment Type: Full\-time, in\-office — Indore, India
 



 • Starting Compensation: ₹20,000–35,000/month to start (see note below)
 



 • Tooling Provided: AI \& productivity tooling — on THH
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 THE OFFER
 



 Most job posts give you a task list, a manager three levels up, and a generic perks page. Here's the actual offer — laid out so you can evaluate it clearly.
 



  





 • Ship on Live Products
 



 Why it matters: Real products, paying clients, real users. Not mock apps. What most developers spend years trying to get on their resume.
 



  





 • Modern AI Toolchain, On Us
 



 Why it matters: AI coding tools, LLM access, and automation platforms — the tools senior engineers usually pay for out of their own pocket. Meaningful market value, provided free while you work here.
 



  





 • Direct Founder Access
 



 Why it matters: You report to the Full\-Stack Lead and have a direct line to the founders. No layers, no bureaucracy. Mentorship most developers don't get until years into a career.
 



  





 • Full Portfolio Attribution
 



 Why it matters: Every task you ship is credited to you — git commits, live URLs, build records, yours to claim. A real, attributable track record. Not "contributed to a team project."
 



  





 • Real Ownership From Day One
 



 Why it matters: Your first real task ships in week one, on a live product. Not a sandbox, not onboarding busywork. Immediate proof, immediate feedback, immediate confidence.
 



  





 • Room to Grow
 



 Why it matters: Compensation and scope are reviewed as you prove impact — this range is a starting point, not a ceiling. Upside for people who perform, without a capped band to work against.
 



  





 A note on pay: we're starting new hires in the ₹20,000–35,000/month range while we calibrate to the market and the calibre of people applying. The final offer is based on the skill you demonstrate through the hiring process, and it moves fast for people who prove themselves.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 THE COMPANY
 



 The Hustle House is a founder\-led, AI\-native studio building brands, digital products, and growth systems for clients who expect premium performance. Intentionally small. Tight senior crew. Fast.
 



  





 We build and ship live products for real, paying clients — not prototypes, not concepts. You'd be working directly with the same small team that builds and runs them.
 



 No management layers, no 60\-day onboarding plans, no busywork that goes nowhere.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 THE STACK
 



 • Languages \& runtimes: JavaScript / Node.js, Python, React
 



 • Infrastructure: Cloud infrastructure, REST APIs, webhooks
 



 • AI tooling: AI coding assistants, LLM APIs, automation \& voice\-AI platforms
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 THE ROLE
 



 What This Is
 



 You'll handle well\-defined development work that becomes critical infrastructure for our live products — the kind of work that quietly blocks the senior team until someone owns it. This isn't a training role. You'll be shipping production code in week one, and your scope grows as fast as you do.
 



  





 Who This Is For
 



 • You've built and shipped something — a side project, a freelance gig, a tool people actually use.
 



 • You can show it or explain it clearly.
 



 • You're comfortable reading and writing code in at least one language. JS or Python preferred.
 



 • You debug independently. You read the error before asking for help.
 



 • You're reliable. If it's due tomorrow, it's done tomorrow.
 



 • You build things whether or not someone is paying you to.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 



 • Build and maintain features across our live, revenue\-generating products.
 



 • Own live integrations — webhook endpoints, API connections, data pipeline fixes.
 



 • Ship bug patches, test runs, data cleanups, and minor feature builds independently.
 



 • Flag things that look broken, even if it isn't your task.
 



 • Work directly with the Full\-Stack Lead on architecture decisions as your ownership grows.
 



  





 Bonus — Nice to Have
 



 • You've used AI coding tools, or are actively learning them.
 



 • You've touched webhooks, APIs, or automation platforms.
 



 • You have a GitHub with real activity. Size doesn't matter. Consistency does.
 



 • Startup, freelance, or founder\-mode experience.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 THE FIRST 90 DAYS
 



 • Day 30: Your first feature is live on a real product. You know the codebase well enough to move without asking where things are.
 



 • Day 60: You're closing tasks without hand\-holding. You've caught and flagged at least one issue the senior team missed.
 



 • Day 90: You're taking on bigger, less\-defined pieces. Your scope and compensation are reviewed based on impact.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 BE AWARE
 



 No HR department. No fixed increment cycles. No big\-company benefits — health insurance, PF, and paid leave aren't part of the package yet, and we'd rather tell you that upfront than have you find out later.
 



  





 What there is: real ownership, direct founder access, and a toolchain most companies won't give a junior developer.
 



  





 If you need a structured environment with a defined career ladder to stay motivated, this isn't the right fit yet — and that's okay. If what you just read sounds like exactly what you've been looking for, keep going.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 OUR COMMITMENT
 



 • Real production work from week one. Not busywork.
 



 • Direct access to the founders. Not a middle manager.
 



 • Every tool you need — modern AI stack included — at no cost to you.
 



 • Full attribution for everything you ship. Your commits are your portfolio.
 



 • Compensation reviewed transparently as you prove impact.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





 NEXT STEP — HOW TO APPLY
 



 Send your CV to sanidhya@thehustlehouseofficial.com or ishaan@thehustlehouseofficial.com.
 



  





 In three to five sentences: what have you built, what problem did it solve, and what would you do differently if you started today? That's the only filter.
 



  





 We don't care about your GPA. We care about what you've shipped. Link your GitHub, live project, or portfolio if you have one — if you don't, make the written answer specific enough to make up for it.
 



  





 One seat. We read every application. If yours describes something real, we'll respond fast.

**About the role :**
 The HR Generalist plays a key role in delivering Global HR Service Delivery through seamless, high\-quality support across the employee lifecycle.
   

  

 This role combines end\-to\-end HR operations execution, process knowledge, and digital enablement to deliver a human\-centric, compliant, and efficient employee experience.
   

  

 Working within a clustered HR model supporting both assigned areas and broader team demand, the HR Generalist supports Tier 2 queries, manages HR transactions, and actively contributes to HR transformation, process design, and workflow optimisation.
   

  

 The role partners closely with other stakeholders in HR to ensure accurate, timely, and seamless service delivery, while leveraging digital HR tools, automation, and AI\-enabled content to continuously improve how work gets done.
   

  

**HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management:**
* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle activities including hire, job changes, leave of absence, and termination
* Actively drive deflection of Tier 1 queries to self\-service and AI\-enabled front door solutions, improving efficiency and employee experience
* Resolve Tier 2 employee and manager queries across multiple channels (Calls, Video Service Now, HR portal, email, etc.)
* Execute HR transactions in systems such as Workday, and ServiceNow with high accuracy and timeliness
* Govern and generate HR documentation, leveraging standardised templates and further the AI\-enabled document creation capabilities in the future to improve speed, accuracy and employee experience.
* Act as a human\-in\-the\-loop reviewer for AI\-generated content, ensuring accuracy, compliance, tone and alignment with policy.
* Apply global HR standards consistently across lifecycle activities, ensuring governance, compliance and local regulatory alignment.
* Enable and guide people leaders to navigate core HR processes using standardised guidance, self\-service channels and AI\-enabled support, ensuring alignment with global standards while applying appropriate judgement for complex or sensitive cases.


**Employee Experience \& Service Excellence:**
* Deliver a human\-centric experience, balancing digital solutions with personal interaction
* Provide direct employee and people leader support across channels, including phone and video, ensuring complex or sensitive matters are handled with empathy and professionalism.
* Provide a seamless, consistent experience across all employee and manager interactions
* Champion a culture of exceptional service, empathy, and responsiveness across People Solutions.
* Ensure a consistent and high\-quality experience across the employee journey (onboarding through exit)
* Support adoption of self\-service tools, HR portals, and AI\-driven HR solutions


**Process Improvement, Automation \& Governance:**

* Ensure data accuracy, documentation, and compliance across all HR processes


**Data, Insights \& Digital HR Enablement:**
* Ensure data integrity and accuracy across HR systems and reporting
* Support reporting, dashboards, and insights to improve operational decision\-making
* Leverage digital HR tools and analytics to enhance service delivery and efficiency
* Identify trends in queries and processes to inform improvements and proactive solutions


**Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration (One HR):**

* May act as a process and systems expert, supporting training and guidance where needed
* Collaborate across global teams to deliver consistent and scalable services
* Support cross\-functional initiatives and contribute to HR transformation programmes


**Key Skills \& Capabilities:**
* Strong experience in HR Operations / Employee Lifecycle Management
* Knowledge of HR Systems (Workday, SAP, ServiceNow)
* Experience handling high\-volume query resolution (Tier 1 \& Tier 2\)
* Strong focus on process design, continuous improvement, and automation
* Proven ability to operate in a global, matrixed environment
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to use data to drive insights and improvements
* Demonstrated human\-centric approach with focus on employee experience

* Familiarity with case management systems (ServiceNow) and Workday

* Exposure to global HR processes and compliance requirements

title: Associate Manager Human Resources
description:
**1\. Summary** 


 We are seeking a proactive, organized, and people\-centric professional to join
 
**Chhanv Foundation** 

 as a
 
**Human Resource Associate Manager** 

 . The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in managing the organization's human resource functions while ensuring seamless coordination between employees, acid attack survivors, departments, stakeholders, partner organizations, vendors, and external agencies.
 





 This position extends beyond conventional Human Resources and requires an individual who can effectively manage recruitment, employee engagement, administration, stakeholder communication, event coordination, travel logistics, office administration, and organizational operations. The Human Resource Associate Manager will serve as a key coordination point for internal teams and external stakeholders, ensuring smooth execution of organizational programmes, campaigns, workshops, awareness events, training sessions, and institutional partnerships.
 





 The candidate should possess excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, maintain the highest level of confidentiality, demonstrate empathy while working with acid attack survivors, and contribute towards strengthening organizational culture, operational excellence, and employee experience.
 



**2\. Line of Reporting** 


 The Human Resource Associate Manager reports directly to the Board of Directors of the organization.
 



**3\. Responsibilities** 


 The role will include the following core responsibilities:
 



**Human Resource Management** 
* Manage the complete employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, induction, confirmation, performance management, employee engagement, promotions, transfers, and exit formalities.
* Coordinate the recruitment process by screening applications, scheduling interviews, communicating with candidates, maintaining recruitment records, and supporting hiring managers throughout the selection process.
* Prepare and maintain HR documentation, including offer letters, appointment letters, employment contracts, confirmation letters, increment letters, experience letters, warning letters, policies, and other employment\-related documents.
* Maintain employee records, attendance, leave management, personnel files, and HR databases while ensuring confidentiality and compliance.
* Coordinate orientation programmes and facilitate smooth onboarding of employees, interns, consultants, fellows, volunteers, and programme staff.
* Support implementation and communication of HR policies, organizational procedures, Code of Conduct, disciplinary processes, and employee welfare initiatives.
* Coordinate performance appraisal processes, employee development plans, training schedules, and internal capacity\-building programmes.
* Prepare HR reports, employee MIS, attendance summaries, and other organizational reports as required by senior management.
* Foster a positive, inclusive, and professional workplace culture aligned with the mission and values of Chhanv Foundation.


**Event \& Stakeholder Communication Management** 
* Manage end\-to\-end communication for organizational events, workshops, campaigns, conferences, awareness programmes, meetings, media engagements, fundraising initiatives, institutional collaborations, and stakeholder visits.
* Maintain the organization's annual event calendar and coordinate scheduling with internal teams, partner organizations, educational institutions, corporates, donors, supporters, government agencies, and other stakeholders.
* Act as the primary point of contact for all event\-related communication from planning through successful execution.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to finalize schedules, agendas, participant lists, logistical requirements, approvals, and communication timelines.
* Liaise with internal departments including Reachout, Rehabilitation, Sheroes Hangout Café, Welfare, Legal, Communications, Finance, and Administration to ensure smooth implementation of every activity.
* Coordinate continuously with acid attack survivors participating in workshops, campaigns, exhibitions, awareness programmes, training sessions, conferences, and public engagements to ensure timely communication and participation.
* Monitor the progress of scheduled activities and proactively resolve coordination challenges before and during programme execution.
* Prepare event briefs, attendance records, schedules, minutes of meetings, post\-event reports, and follow\-up documentation.
* Share regular updates and status reports with senior management regarding ongoing and upcoming organizational activities.


**Travel, Logistics \& Office Administration** 
* Manage end\-to\-end travel coordination for employees, acid attack survivors, consultants, trainers, senior management, guests, and volunteers participating in official programmes, meetings, workshops, campaigns, conferences, and organizational events.
* Coordinate with the organization's approved travel vendors for booking flight tickets, train tickets, bus tickets, accommodation, local transportation, and other travel\-related requirements while ensuring cost optimization and timely confirmations.
* Prepare and communicate comprehensive travel itineraries containing travel schedules, booking confirmations, accommodation details, reporting instructions, emergency contacts, and relevant travel information to all concerned stakeholders.
* Liaise with travellers, vendors, internal departments, and senior management to ensure seamless travel arrangements and timely resolution of travel\-related issues.
* Coordinate office administration and vendor management for procurement of stationery, office supplies, equipment, furniture, consumables, housekeeping requirements, and other operational necessities while ensuring quality, timely delivery, and cost efficiency.
* Maintain a structured inventory management system for all organizational assets and office resources from procurement until their complete lifecycle.
* Ensure proper documentation and secure filing of purchase records, invoices, warranty cards, warranty certificates, user manuals, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), and related asset documentation.
* Maintain accurate asset registers, inventory records, inward and outward movement registers, allocation records, maintenance history, repair logs, and disposal records for all organizational assets.
* Ensure proper tagging, identification, issuance, transfer, return, servicing, replacement, and disposal of organizational assets in accordance with organizational procedures.
* Coordinate allocation of laptops, mobile phones, office equipment, and other organizational assets to employees, interns, consultants, volunteers, or acid attack survivors through appropriate documentation and acknowledgement.
* Conduct periodic physical verification of assets and inventory to ensure accountability, proper utilization, timely maintenance, and record accuracy.
* Coordinate with vendors for repairs, warranty claims, preventive maintenance, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), and servicing of office equipment and infrastructure.


**Administration \& Organizational Coordination** 
* Coordinate internal meetings, prepare meeting agendas, record minutes, monitor action points, and ensure timely follow\-up.
* Support preparation of organizational reports, presentations, proposals, donor documentation, and internal communication materials.
* Coordinate with vendors, consultants, trainers, institutions, and service providers for administrative requirements.
* Ensure confidentiality of employee information, survivor information, donor information, organizational records, and sensitive documentation.
* Assist senior management in administrative planning, compliance, documentation, and organizational operations.
* Perform additional responsibilities assigned by the Board of Directors in alignment with organizational priorities.


**4\. Requirements** 


 The Human Resource Associate Manager should possess:
 



* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Social Work, Psychology, Public Administration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in Human Resources, Administration, Operations, Programme Coordination, or NGO management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong interpersonal, coordination, negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent organizational, planning, multitasking, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience in recruitment, employee engagement, HR documentation, event coordination, and administration.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, presentations, documentation, and online collaboration tools.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* High level of professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, empathy, and cultural sensitivity.
* Willingness to travel whenever organizational requirements arise.


**5\. Work Location** 


 The selected candidate will be based at
 
**Chhanv Foundation, D\-45, Sector 48, Gautam Buddh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh** 

 , with travel as required for organizational programmes, meetings, workshops, awareness campaigns, and partner engagements.
 



**6\. Perks** 


 The initial remuneration for this position will be between
 
**₹40,000 and ₹50,000 per month** 

 , depending upon the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and suitability for the role. The final compensation package will be discussed during the selection process.

 Working closely with Engineering teams and stakeholders across Finance Data Transformation team, you will help Engineering team deliver high\-performing solutions through agile delivery models.
   

  

 Leading the ongoing drive to enhance platform performance and reliability, you will champion a data\-driven and collaborative approach, ensuring that performance considerations are embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. Additionally, ensuring compliance with performance standards, risk controls, and service\-level expectations will be a key responsibility.

* Understanding of data integration concepts, including APIs and data transfer mechanisms.

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The location of the role is Chennai, IN

 To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.

* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. What would you do to create a trusted marketplace where millions of buyers and sellers can safely transact online? What kinds of processes and systems would you build to maximize customer satisfaction? Amazon is seeking a Business Analyst who will be responsible for analyzing trends, creating forecasts, and most importantly finding and executing opportunity areas to help our customers.
   

  

 Our overall mission is simple: We want Amazon to be the place where our customers can find, discover and buy anything online. Whatever our customers want, we will find the means to deliver it. With your help, Amazon will continue to enable people to discover new worlds. This is your chance to make history.
   

  

 We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build trust of our customers and sellers. Amazon hires the brightest minds, are you one of them?
   

  

 At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and intelligence driven people. The ideal candidate is expected to operate with significant autonomy and discretion, and leverage data to influence partner teams. He/She will possess advanced analytical experience and basic knowledge of workforce management metrics. The individual must be capable to support and proactively own tactical and strategic data analysis driven projects to address customer facing challenges and enable program management and decision making initiatives across SEPO. In this role you will experience a wide range of challenges and we expect you to approach the problems with swift data driven solutions.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Work with large data sets to identify relationships, trends, patterns.
   

  

 Write SQL queries, create ETL, create dashboards with relevant business metrics.
   

  

 Work closely with Business and Product teams to understand their roadmap and impact on downstream data.
   

  

 Create accurate forecasts for partner teams (WFM and Operations) to enable them to build the right capacity.
   

  

 Analyze variances between forecast and actuals to course correct and prevent further variance.
   

  

 Identify downstream impact on Operations metrics and work backwards from there.
   

  

 Mine for opportunities and pain points, identify relevant solution, and execute to drive impact.
   

  

 Interact with partner teams, obtain required information, share relevant details, and drive discussions using data and Amazon’s customer\-centric culture.
   

  

 Provide regular and proactive updates with clear communication to partner teams.

* 3\+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience

**What to Have for this position.**

* Strong Oracle database skills: able to read and act on AWR reports, analyze top SQL queries, manage indexes, disable/enable FK constraints, and apply table/index compression.
* Proficient in data preparation for batch testing: masking scripts, data exclusion, SIT\-to\-performance environment cloning, volume scaling.
* Excellent analytical and root cause analysis skills \- able to trace batch slowness to specific SQL queries, locking contention, I/O saturation, or application\-layer issues.
* Capable of architecting the performance test strategy for batch\-heavy systems: defining KPIs, thresholds, batch cycle windows, and concurrency models.
* Strong scripting ability (SQL, Shell, Python, or Java) to automate test data setup and environment preparation.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English \- able to produce executive\-level performance reports and lead technical review sessions.

**Must have Skills**
* BSc in computer science or equivalent
* 4\+ years’ experience as a performance engineer
* Good hands\-on experience with JMeter or similar Performance testing tool
* Experience with designing different types of performance strategies
* Proven experience with DBs querying
* Experience with Batch and Web Services Performance testing
* Experience with AppDynamics/ Dynatrace or similar APM tools – Advantage
* Experience with profiling tools like Your Kit or similar profiling tools – Advantage
* Experience with Java programming language – Advantage
* Experience with Linux/Unix platforms including monitoring – Advantage.
* Experience in the Insurance industry – Advantage
* Ability to travel according to demand (Approx. 15% of the time)


**AI Tools \& Skills**
 Sapiens requires all engineers in this role to actively use AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as productivity accelerators throughout the performance engineering lifecycle. The following are the expected areas of AI\-assisted work:
   

  

* AWR/ASH Report Interpretation – Use AI tools to interpret Oracle AWR and ASH reports, identify top SQL consumers, and receive tuning recommendations for batch jobs such as Billing Batch, RI Process Coordinator, and GL Export.
* Proactive Batch Monitoring – Use AI\-enhanced APM tools (e.g., Dynatrace AI/Davis engine) to proactively detect batch performance anomalies, resource saturation, and regression patterns before they are escalated — shifting from reactive to predictive performance monitoring.
* SQL Query Tuning \& Script Generation – Use AI to analyze slow SQL queries, suggest index strategies, generate FK disable/enable scripts, and draft Oracle compression estimation scripts, reducing manual effort on repetitive DB tasks.
* Test Script Generation \& Coverage – Use AI\-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude) to generate and review performance test scripts for batch jobs, accelerate scripting of new test scenarios, and improve test coverage through intelligent test case suggestion.
* Test Data Preparation – Use AI to generate data masking scripts, data exclusion queries, and environment\-cloning runbooks for migrated datasets, ensuring clean batch testing starting points without corrupted or cut\-off records.
* Performance Test Strategy \& Planning – Use AI to draft performance test plans, define KPI thresholds for batch windows, generate test scenario structures, and review test coverage for completeness before presenting to stakeholders.
* Root Cause Analysis Support – Use AI to correlate batch execution logs, SQL wait events, and monitoring metrics, accelerating root cause identification for issues such as locking contention, I/O saturation, or application\-layer bottlenecks.
* Predictive Analytics \& Capacity Planning – Apply AI\-driven predictive analytics to forecast batch processing trends, identify gradual performance degradation across releases, and support capacity planning decisions based on historical test data — enabling proactive infrastructure sizing before go\-live.
* Performance Report Generation – Use AI to draft executive\-level performance cycle reports, summarize batch execution results, produce before/after comparison narratives, and create structured stakeholder\-facing summaries aligned with Sapiens reporting standards.
* Defect Writing \& Documentation – Use AI to compose high\-quality defect descriptions with clear steps to reproduce, supporting data, and root cause hypotheses; generate runbooks and knowledge\-base articles for recurring batch issues.
* Domain Ramp\-Up – Use AI to quickly understand RI/SRM business processes (Reinsurance cycles, GL reconciliation, billing workflows) by querying AI tools for explanations, reducing the onboarding time required to become effective in the insurance back\-office domain.
* Architecture Review Assistance – Use AI to review sizing documents, environment proposals, and batch architecture diagrams, identifying potential performance risks and generating structured technical review questions before meetings with architects and developers.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Capable of working independently, highly motivated, and organized.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Proven ability to drill down into Performance results and complete deep\-dive root cause analysis.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English
* Ability to learn new tools \& technologies quickly.
* Proactive and initiative approach

description:
**Job Summary** 




 The Junior IT Hardware Technician is responsible for providing first\-level IT hardware and network support across the organization. The role includes installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of computer systems, peripherals, network devices, and CCTV surveillance systems to ensure smooth business operations.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Install, configure, and maintain desktop computers, laptops, printers, scanners, biometric devices, and other IT peripherals.

* Support data backup, antivirus installation, system updates, and IT security practices.
* Maintain service records, asset movement logs, and preventive maintenance schedules.
* Ensure compliance with the organization's IT and information security policies.
* Assist in IT infrastructure expansion and office/factory workstation setup.



**Qualifications** 



* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Hardware \& Networking, or a related discipline.

**Experience** 



* 0–2 years of experience in IT hardware support, desktop support, hardware maintenance, or CCTV installation.
* Freshers with relevant technical training in Hardware, Networking, and CCTV systems may also apply.



**Required Skills** 



* Good knowledge of computer hardware assembly, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
* Basic knowledge of Windows operating systems and Microsoft Office.
* Working knowledge of LAN, TCP/IP, Wi\-Fi, routers, switches, and network troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of CCTV camera installation, DVR/NVR configuration, IP cameras, cable routing, and fault diagnosis.
* Familiarity with biometric attendance devices and network printers is preferred.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and customer support skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

title: Robotics Research Resident: Localization and Mapping
description:
**Company Description** 
 Bizom is a route\-to\-market and retail intelligence platform that helps CPG brands digitize, optimize, and scale their sales and distribution operations. It unifies sales force automation, distributor management, and retailer engagement so brands can decide where, what, and how much to sell with greater accuracy. By combining AI with real\-time data and industry expertise, Bizom creates a connected, insight\-driven ecosystem that improves retail execution and decision\-making across sales, distribution, and supply chain. The platform is built to perform reliably in complex, multi\-geography environments, supporting large field teams and millions of endpoints worldwide. Trusted by over 750 brands in more than 35 countries, Bizom enables organizations to reduce inefficiencies, boost sales productivity, optimize inventory, and accelerate market expansion.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Robotics Research Resident: Localization and Mapping will focus on designing, implementing, and evaluating algorithms for robot localization, mapping, and navigation in real\-world retail and distribution environments. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include developing and testing SLAM and related perception pipelines, integrating sensor data from sources such as LiDAR, cameras, and IMUs, and optimizing algorithms for robustness and performance in complex, dynamic settings. The resident will work closely with cross\-functional teams to build prototypes, run experiments, analyze results, and translate research outcomes into deployable components within Bizom’s intelligent RTM ecosystem. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Bengaluru, requiring regular collaboration with engineering, data science, and product teams to align research with practical business applications.

* Strong foundation in robotics, computer science, or a related field, with knowledge of localization, mapping, and motion planning concepts.

* Skills in working with common robotics frameworks and tools, such as ROS/ROS2, Gazebo, or similar simulation and integration environments.
* Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in robotics research, such as C\+\+, Python, and relevant libraries (e.g., Eigen, OpenCV, PCL).
* Ability to process and integrate data from perception sensors including cameras, LiDAR, depth sensors, and IMUs in real\-world conditions.
* Familiarity with machine learning or computer vision techniques that enhance mapping, environment understanding, or navigation performance.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to design experiments, interpret results, and iterate on research ideas.
* Comfort working on\-site in Bengaluru in a collaborative, interdisciplinary team, with clear written and verbal communication skills.

* Awareness of modern Android development tools and architecture (MVVM, Jetpack components, etc.).
* Eagerness to learn and work in a collaborative, mission\-driven team.
* Strong communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Prior exposure to unit testing or UI testing is a plus.
* Interest in SDK development , digital identity , or mobile security is a strong plus.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent technical field.
* Strong grasp of programming fundamentals – data structures, OOP, algorithms.
* Willingness to work in an agile, fast\-paced, and feedback\-driven startup environment.
* Passion for building clean, intuitive, and impactful mobile experiences.
* Knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
* Strong focus on clean code and robust design and test\-driven development.
* Ability to work well with people and be both highly motivated and motivating


**About Vida**
 What are we trying to solve?
   

  

 We have 7\.5 billion people on Earth, of which over 1 billion cannot securely prove their identity right now.
   

  

 Every year, 140 million babies are born, of which 40 million go unregistered.
   

  

 Simply put, these people are deprived of social benefits, such as education and health, their civil rights to vote and travel; and are excluded from the economy because they cannot sign up for bank accounts, loans, welfare programs etc. We believe this is unacceptable and needs to change.
   

  

 At VIDA, we are creating a frictionless digital identity system. One that fulfills the needs and expectations of our times, and is available anywhere, for everyone.
   

  

 Why are we solving this problem?
   

  

 The United Nations (UN) and World Bank ID4D initiatives aim to provide everyone on the planet with a legal identity by 2030\. This deadline is just 9 years away, we are expecting a digital identity to be a legal human right by then and we at VIDA want to be pioneers in leading this change.
   

  

 Who are we?
   

  

 We are a highly driven bunch of people to solve this problem for our own reasons. Whether it is to solve for misleading doctors, or because we didn’t get access to fair ration due to corruption \- Our collective goal aligns.
   

  

 Other things that we care about:
   

  

* Our mission is to enable trust, so what we do is pretty serious stuff – we work hard and we have audacious goals. We balance it through humor and making sure we have fun at work. We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously.
* We are a startup so at times we will do things that are outside our scope. We do it to learn but we also do it because it takes a village.
* We believe feedback is a gift and should be given freely, constructively, and in a respectful manner.
* We are accountable to many stakeholders, but first and foremost, we are accountable to our mission and each other
